 81:     for (const option of timeOptions) {
 82:         const button = document.createElement('button');
 83:         button.type = 'button';
 84:         button.textContent = option;
 85:         button.dataset.timeValue = option;
 86:         button.setAttribute('role', 'option');
 87: 
 88:         grid.append(button);
 89:     }
 90: 
 91:     timePickerMenu.append(grid);
 92: 
 93:     document.body.append(timePickerMenu);
 94: 
 95:     return timePickerMenu;
 96: };
 97: 
 98: const closeTimePicker = () => {
 99:     if (timePickerMenu) {
100:         timePickerMenu.hidden = true;
101:     }
102: 
103:     activeTimeInput = null;
104: };
105: 
106: const positionTimePicker = (input) => {
107:     const menu = ensureTimePickerMenu();
108:     const rect = input.getBoundingClientRect();
109:     const top = window.innerHeight - rect.bottom - 16 >= menu.offsetHeight
110:         ? rect.bottom + 6
111:         : Math.max(16, rect.top - menu.offsetHeight - 6);
112: 
113:     menu.style.left = `${Math.max(16, Math.min(rect.right + 8, window.innerWidth - menu.offsetWidth - 16))}px`;
114:     menu.style.top = `${Math.max(16, top)}px`;
115: };
116: 
117: const openFallbackTimePicker = (input) => {
118:     activeTimeInput = input;
119:     const menu = ensureTimePickerMenu();
120: 
121:     for (const button of menu.querySelectorAll('button')) {
122:         button.setAttribute('aria-selected', button.dataset.timeValue === input.value ? 'true' : 'false');
123:     }
124: 
125:     menu.hidden = false;
126:     positionTimePicker(input);
127: };
128: 
129: document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
130:     const timeInput = event.target.closest('input[data-time-picker]');
131: 
132:     if (! timeInput || timeInput.disabled) {
133:         return;
134:     }
135: 
136:     event.preventDefault();
137:     timeInput.focus();
138:     openFallbackTimePicker(timeInput);
139: });
140: 
141: document.addEventListener('input', (event) => {
142:     const timeInput = event.target.closest('input[data-time-picker]:not([readonly])');
143: 
144:     if (! timeInput) {
145:         return;
146:     }
147: 
148:     const digits = timeInput.value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 4);
149:     timeInput.value = digits.length > 2 ? `${digits.slice(0, 2)}:${digits.slice(2)}` : digits;
150:     timeInput.setCustomValidity('');
151: });
152: 
153: document.addEventListener('invalid', (event) => {
154:     const timeInput = event.target.closest('input[data-time-picker]:not([readonly])');
155: 
156:     if (timeInput) {
157:         timeInput.setCustomValidity('Hora incorrecta');
158:     }
159: }, true);
160: 
161: document.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
162:     const selectedTime = event.target.closest('.time-picker-menu button');
163: 
164:     if (selectedTime && activeTimeInput) {
165:         activeTimeInput.value = selectedTime.dataset.timeValue;
166:         activeTimeInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
167:         activeTimeInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true }));
168:         closeTimePicker();
169: 
170:         return;
171:     }
172: 
173:     if (! event.target.closest('.time-picker-menu, input[data-time-picker]')) {
174:         closeTimePicker();
175:     }
176: });
177: 
178: document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
179:     if (event.key === 'Escape') {
180:         closeTimePicker();
181:     }
182: });
183: 
184: window.addEventListener('resize', closeTimePicker);
````

## File: app/Console/Commands/ResetClientData.php
````php
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: namespace App\Console\Commands;
 4: 
 5: use Database\Seeders\AppointmentSeeder;
 6: use Database\Seeders\ClientSeeder;
 7: use Illuminate\Console\Command;
 8: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
 9: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;
10: 
11: class ResetClientData extends Command
12: {
13:     private const PROTECTED_TABLES = [
14:         'appointment_reminder_preferences',
15:         'app_settings',
16:         'migrations',
17:         'sqlite_sequence',
18:         'twilio_content_templates',
19:         'users',
20:         'whatsapp_credentials',
21:         'whatsapp_sender_numbers',
22:         'whatsapp_messages',
23:     ];
24: 
25:     protected $signature = 'clients:reset-data {--force : Confirm the destructive reset}';
26: 
27:     protected $description = 'Delete and restart all data tables except protected settings tables.';
28: 
29:     public function handle(): int
30:     {
31:         if (! $this->option('force')) {
32:             $this->error('This command is destructive. Re-run with --force.');
33: 
34:             return self::FAILURE;
35:         }
36: 
37:         $tables = collect(Schema::getTables())
38:             ->pluck('name')
39:             ->reject(fn (string $table): bool => in_array($table, self::PROTECTED_TABLES, true))
40:             ->values();
41: 
42:         Schema::disableForeignKeyConstraints();
43: 
44:         try {
45:             foreach ($tables as $table) {
46:                 DB::table($table)->delete();
47:                 $this->restartIdentity($table);
48:             }
49:         } finally {
50:             Schema::enableForeignKeyConstraints();
51:         }
52: 
53:         $this->info(sprintf(
54:             'Deleted and restarted %d table(s): %s.',
55:             $tables->count(),
56:             $tables->implode(', '),
57:         ));
58:         $this->callSilent('db:seed', [
59:             '--class' => ClientSeeder::class,
60:             '--force' => true,
61:         ]);
62:         $this->callSilent('db:seed', [
63:             '--class' => AppointmentSeeder::class,
64:             '--force' => true,
65:         ]);
66: 
67:         $this->info('ClientSeeder and AppointmentSeeder executed.');
68:         $this->info('Protected tables were not changed.');
69: 
70:         return self::SUCCESS;
71:     }
72: 
73:     private function restartIdentity(string $table): void
74:     {
75:         $driver = DB::connection()->getDriverName();
76: 
77:         if ($driver === 'mysql') {
78:             DB::statement('ALTER TABLE '.$this->wrapTable($table).' AUTO_INCREMENT = 1');
79: 
80:             return;
81:         }
82: 
83:         if ($driver === 'sqlite' && Schema::hasTable('sqlite_sequence')) {
84:             DB::table('sqlite_sequence')->where('name', $table)->delete();
85:         }
86:     }
87: 
88:     private function wrapTable(string $table): string
89:     {
90:         return DB::connection()->getQueryGrammar()->wrapTable($table);
91:     }
92: }
````

 79:             $this->importStatusNonce++;

 81: 
 82:             return;

 85:         $decoded = json_decode($json, true);
 86: 
 87:         if (json_last_error() !== JSON_ERROR_NONE) {

 95:         $version = $decoded['version'] ?? null;

 97:         if (! in_array($version, [1, 2], true)) {
 98:             $this->importStatus = "Versión no soportada: {$version}";
 99:             $this->importStatusNonce++;
100:             $this->confirmImport = false;
101: 
102:             return;

105:         $settings = $decoded['settings'] ?? [];

107:         DB::transaction(function () use ($settings, $version): void {
108:             if ($version === 1) {

136:         $this->importCredentials($settings['whatsapp_credentials'] ?? []);

150:                 'twilio_template_appointment_created_id' => $data['twilio_template_appointment_created_id'] ?? null,
151:             ]);
152:         }
153: 
154:         $this->importReminderPreferences($settings['appointment_reminder_preferences'] ?? []);
155:         $this->importCredentials($settings['whatsapp_credentials'] ?? []);
156:         $this->importSenderNumbers($settings['whatsapp_sender_numbers'] ?? []);

160:     private function importFromZip(): void
161:     {
162:         if (! class_exists(ZipArchive::class)) {
163:             $this->importStatus = 'ZipArchive no está disponible en el servidor.';
164:             $this->importStatusNonce++;
165:             $this->confirmImport = false;
166: 
167:             return;
168:         }
169: 
170:         $zipPath = $this->importFile->getRealPath();
171:         $zip = new ZipArchive;
172: 
173:         if ($zip->open($zipPath) !== true) {
174:             $this->importStatus = 'No se pudo abrir el ZIP.';
175:             $this->importStatusNonce++;
176:             $this->confirmImport = false;
177: 
178:             return;
179:         }
180: 
181:         $settings = [];
182: 
183:         for ($i = 0; $i < $zip->numFiles; $i++) {
184:             $filename = $zip->getNameIndex($i);
185: 
186:             if ($filename === false || pathinfo($filename, PATHINFO_EXTENSION) !== 'csv') {
187:                 continue;
188:             }
189: 
190:             $table = pathinfo($filename, PATHINFO_FILENAME);
191:             $settings[$table] = $this->parseCsvFromZip($zip, $filename);
192:         }
193: 
194:         $zip->close();
195: 
196:         DB::transaction(function () use ($settings): void {
197:             if (isset($settings['app_settings'])) {
198:                 $row = $settings['app_settings'][0] ?? [];
199:                 AppSetting::updateOrCreate([], [
200:                     'retention_period' => $row['retention_period'] ?? 'disabled',
201:                     'dispatch_enabled' => $row['dispatch_enabled'] ?? true,
202:                     'dispatch_hours' => $row['dispatch_hours'] ?? ['09:00', '12:00', '15:00'],
203:                     'twilio_template_appointment_reminder_id' => $row['twilio_template_appointment_reminder_id'] ?? null,
204:                     'twilio_template_appointment_created_id' => $row['twilio_template_appointment_created_id'] ?? null,
205:                 ]);
206:             }
207: 
208:             if (isset($settings['appointment_reminder_preferences'])) {
209:                 $this->importReminderPreferences($settings['appointment_reminder_preferences']);
210:             }
211: 
212:             if (isset($settings['whatsapp_credentials'])) {
213:                 $this->importCredentials($settings['whatsapp_credentials']);
214:             }
215: 
216:             if (isset($settings['whatsapp_sender_numbers'])) {
217:                 $this->importSenderNumbers($settings['whatsapp_sender_numbers']);
218:             }
219: 
220:             if (isset($settings['twilio_content_templates'])) {
221:                 $this->importTemplates($settings['twilio_content_templates']);
222:             }
223:         });
224: 
225:         $this->importStatus = 'Ajustes importados correctamente.';
226:         $this->importStatusNonce++;
227:         $this->confirmImport = false;
228:         $this->importFile = null;
229:     }
230: 
231:     private function parseCsvFromZip(ZipArchive $zip, string $filename): array
232:     {
233:         $content = $zip->getFromName($filename);
234: 
235:         if ($content === false) {
236:             return [];
237:         }
238: 
239:         $handle = fopen('php://memory', 'r+');
240:         fwrite($handle, $content);
241:         rewind($handle);
242: 
243:         $headings = fgetcsv($handle);
244:         if ($headings === false) {
245:             fclose($handle);
246: 
247:             return [];
248:         }
249: 
250:         $rows = [];
251: 
252:         while (($row = fgetcsv($handle)) !== false) {
253:             $row = array_combine($headings, $row);
254:             $rows[] = $this->unflattenFromCsv($row);
255:         }
256: 
257:         fclose($handle);
258: 
259:         return $rows;
260:     }
261: 
262:     private function unflattenFromCsv(array $row): array
263:     {
264:         $result = [];
265: 
266:         foreach ($row as $key => $value) {
267:             if ($value === '' || $value === null) {
268:                 $result[$key] = null;
269:             } elseif ($value === '1' && in_array($key, ['enabled', 'seleccionada', 'selected', 'dispatch_enabled'], true)) {
270:                 $result[$key] = true;
271:             } elseif ($value === '0' && in_array($key, ['enabled', 'seleccionada', 'selected', 'dispatch_enabled'], true)) {
272:                 $result[$key] = false;
273:             } elseif ($value !== '' && $this->isJsonString($value)) {
274:                 $result[$key] = json_decode($value, true);
275:             } else {
276:                 $result[$key] = $value;
277:             }
278:         }
279: 
280:         return $result;
281:     }
282: 
283:     private function isJsonString(string $value): bool
284:     {
285:         if ($value[0] !== '{' && $value[0] !== '[') {
286:             return false;
287:         }
288: 
289:         $decoded = json_decode($value, true);
290: 
291:         return json_last_error() === JSON_ERROR_NONE && is_array($decoded);
292:     }
293:

319:                 $existing->update($record);
320:             } else {
321:                 unset($record['id']);
322:                 WhatsAppCredential::create($record);
323:             }
324:         }
325:     }

## File: app/Livewire/AgendaIndex.php
````php
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: namespace App\Livewire;
 4: 
 5: use App\Models\Appointment;
 6: use Carbon\Carbon;
 7: use Illuminate\Support\Collection;
 8: use Illuminate\View\View;
 9: use Livewire\Component;
10: 
11: class AgendaIndex extends Component
12: {
13:     public function render(): View
14:     {
15:         Carbon::setLocale('es');
16:         $selectedMonth = now(config('app.timezone'))->startOfMonth();
17: 
18:         return view('livewire.agenda-index', [
19:             'selectedMonth' => $selectedMonth,
20:             'calendarWeeks' => $this->calendarWeeks($selectedMonth),
21:         ])->extends('layouts.app')->section('content');
22:     }
23: 
24:     private function calendarWeeks(Carbon $selectedMonth): Collection
25:     {
26:         $monthStart = $selectedMonth->copy()->startOfMonth();
27:         $monthEnd = $selectedMonth->copy()->endOfMonth();
28: 
29:         $appointmentsByDate = Appointment::query()
30:             ->with('client')
31:             ->whereBetween('fecha', [
32:                 $monthStart->toDateString(),
33:                 $monthEnd->toDateString(),
34:             ])
35:             ->orderBy('fecha')
36:             ->orderBy('hora')
37:             ->get()
38:             ->groupBy(fn (Appointment $appointment): string => $appointment->fecha->toDateString());
39: 
40:         $days = collect();
41:         $firstCalendarDay = $monthStart->copy()->startOfWeek(Carbon::MONDAY);
42:         $lastCalendarDay = $monthEnd->copy()->endOfWeek(Carbon::SATURDAY);
43: 
44:         for ($date = $firstCalendarDay; $date->lte($lastCalendarDay); $date->addDay()) {
45:             if ($date->isSunday()) {
46:                 continue;
47:             }
48: 
49:             $dateKey = $date->toDateString();
50:             $isCurrentMonth = $date->isSameMonth($selectedMonth);
51: 
52:             $days->push([
53:                 'date' => $date->copy(),
54:                 'is_current_month' => $isCurrentMonth,
55:                 'is_today' => $date->isToday(),
56:                 'appointments' => $isCurrentMonth ? $appointmentsByDate->get($dateKey, collect()) : collect(),
57:             ]);
58:         }
59: 
60:         return $days->chunk(6);
61:     }
62: }
````

 92: 
 93:         $this->clearSelection();
 94:         $this->template_key = WhatsAppTemplate::defaultKey();
 95: 
 96:         $this->statusType = 'success';
 97:         $this->status = 'Mensaje programado desde la ficha del cliente.';
 98:     }
 99: 
100:     public function sendNow(WhatsAppSender $sender): void
101:     {
102:         $data = $this->validate();
103:         $this->validateSelectableDate($data['scheduled_date'], 'scheduled_date');
104: 
105:         $client = Client::query()->findOrFail($data['selectedClientId']);
106:         $scheduledFor = Carbon::parse("{$data['scheduled_date']} {$data['scheduled_time']}");
107:         $message = $this->createManualMessage($client, $scheduledFor, $data['template_key'], [
108:             'immediate_send' => true,
109:             'immediate_sent_at' => now()->toDateTimeString(),
110:         ]);
111: 
112:         SendWhatsAppMessage::dispatchSync($message->id);
113: 
114:         $message->refresh();
115: 
116:         if ($message->status === WhatsAppMessage::STATUS_SENT) {
117:             $this->statusType = 'success';
118:             $this->status = 'WhatsApp enviado ahora y registrado correctamente.';
119:         } else {
120:             $this->statusType = 'error';
121:             $this->status = 'No se pudo enviar el WhatsApp. El intento ha quedado registrado como fallido.';
122:         }
123:     }
124: 
125:     public function render()
126:     {
127:         $clients = Client::query()
128:             ->when($this->filter_nombre, fn ($query) => $query->where('nombre', 'like', '%'.$this->filter_nombre.'%'))
129:             ->when($this->filter_apellidos, fn ($query) => $query->where('apellidos', 'like', '%'.$this->filter_apellidos.'%'))
130:             ->when($this->filter_telefono, fn ($query) => $query->where('telefono', 'like', '%'.$this->filter_telefono.'%'))
131:             ->orderByDesc('created_at')
132:             ->paginate(15, ['*'], 'clientsPage');
133: 
134:         $selectedClient = $this->selectedClientId
135:             ? Client::query()->find($this->selectedClientId)
136:             : null;
137: 
138:         return view('livewire.client-message-scheduler', [
139:             'clients' => $clients,
140:             'selectedClient' => $selectedClient,
141:             'templateOptions' => WhatsAppMessage::templateOptions(),
142:             'previewMessage' => $selectedClient
143:                 ? WhatsAppMessage::buildMessage([
144:                     'nombre' => $selectedClient->nombre,
145:                     'apellidos' => $selectedClient->apellidos,
146:                     'telefono' => $selectedClient->telefono,
147:                     'scheduled_for' => Carbon::parse(
148:                         ($this->scheduled_date ?: now()->toDateString()).' '.($this->scheduled_time ?: now()->format('H:i'))
149:                     ),
150:                 ], $this->template_key ?: WhatsAppTemplate::defaultKey())
151:                 : 'Selecciona un cliente para generar su cita.',
152:             'minimumSelectableDate' => now()->addDay()->toDateString(),
153:         ]);
154:     }
155: 
156:     protected function rules(): array
157:     {
158:         $templateKeys = implode(',', array_column(WhatsAppMessage::templateOptions(), 'key'));
159: 
160:         return [
161:             'selectedClientId' => ['required', 'integer', 'exists:clients,id'],
162:             'scheduled_date' => ['required', Rule::date()->afterToday()],
163:             'scheduled_time' => ['required', 'date_format:H:i'],
164:             'template_key' => ['required', 'in:'.$templateKeys],
165:         ];
166:     }
167: 
168:     protected function messages(): array
169:     {
170:         return [
171:             'scheduled_date.after' => 'La fecha debe ser posterior a hoy.',
172:         ];
173:     }
174: 
175:     /**
176:      * @param  array<string, mixed>  $metadata
177:      */
178:     private function createManualMessage(Client $client, Carbon $scheduledFor, string $templateKey, array $metadata = []): WhatsAppMessage
179:     {
180:         $message = WhatsAppMessage::buildMessage([
181:             'nombre' => $client->nombre,
182:             'apellidos' => $client->apellidos,
183:             'telefono' => $client->telefono,
184:             'scheduled_for' => $scheduledFor,
185:         ], $templateKey);
186: 
187:         return WhatsAppMessage::create([
188:             'user_id' => Auth::id(),
189:             'client_id' => $client->id,
190:             'nombre' => $client->nombre,
191:             'apellidos' => $client->apellidos,
192:             'telefono' => $client->telefono,
193:             'scheduled_for' => $scheduledFor,
194:             'message' => $message,
195:             'source' => WhatsAppMessage::SOURCE_MANUAL,
196:             'status' => WhatsAppMessage::STATUS_PENDING,
197:             'metadata' => [
198:                 'template_key' => $templateKey,
199:                 'origin_client_id' => $client->id,
200:                 ...$metadata,
201:             ],
202:         ]);
203:     }
204: 
205:     private function nextSelectableDate(): string
206:     {
207:         $date = now()->addDay();
208: 
209:         while ($date->isSunday()) {
210:             $date->addDay();
211:         }
212: 
213:         return $date->toDateString();
214:     }
215: }
````

## File: app/Traits/NormalizesPhone.php
````php
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: namespace App\Traits;
 4: 
 5: use App\Models\WhatsAppCredential;
 6: 
 7: trait NormalizesPhone
 8: {
 9:     public static function normalizePhone(string $phone): string
10:     {
11:         $cleaned = preg_replace('/^whatsapp:/i', '', trim($phone)) ?? trim($phone);
12:         $digits = preg_replace('/\D+/', '', $cleaned) ?? '';
13: 
14:         if ($digits === '') {
15:             return '';
16:         }
17: 
18:         $countryCode = preg_replace('/\D+/', '', (string) WhatsAppCredential::get()->resolveDefaultCountryCode()) ?? '34';
19: 
20:         if (str_starts_with($digits, $countryCode)) {
21:             return substr($digits, strlen($countryCode));
22:         }
23: 
24:         return str_starts_with($cleaned, '+') ? '+'.$digits : $digits;
25:     }
26: 
27:     public static function normalizeInternationalPhone(string $phone): string
28:     {
29:         $normalized = static::normalizePhone($phone);
30: 
31:         if ($normalized === '' || str_starts_with($normalized, '+')) {
32:             return $normalized;
33:         }
34: 
35:         return WhatsAppCredential::get()->resolveDefaultCountryCode().$normalized;
36:     }
37: 
38:     public static function normalizeWhatsAppAddress(string $address): string
39:     {
40:         return str_starts_with($address, 'whatsapp:') ? $address : 'whatsapp:'.ltrim($address);
41:     }
42: 
43:     public static function normalizeWhatsAppRecipient(string $recipient): string
44:     {
45:         $normalized = static::normalizeInternationalPhone($recipient);
46: 
47:         return $normalized !== '' ? 'whatsapp:'.$normalized : '';
48:     }
49: }
````

  1: # Guia para retomar el trabajo
  2: 
  3: Proyecto: `citasdentista`
  4: 
  5: Ruta local: `/Users/juanjose/PhpstormProjects/citasdentista`
  6: 
  7: ## Ponytail
  8: 
  9: Este proyecto usa [`@dietrichgebert/ponytail`](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail) (configurado en `opencode.json`). Los agentes DEBEN aplicar la escalera Ponytail antes de escribir código:
 10: 
 11: 1. ¿Esto necesita existir? → Si no, saltar (YAGNI)
 12: 2. ¿Ya existe en este codebase? → Reusar patrones/helpers existentes
 13: 3. ¿Lo hace stdlib? → Usar funciones nativas de Laravel/PHP/Blade
 14: 4. ¿Feature nativa de la plataforma? → Usar HTML/Livewire/Browser APIs primero
 15: 5. ¿Dependencia instalada? → Usar Flux, Livewire, etc. — no añadir paquetes nuevos
 16: 6. ¿Una línea? → Una línea
 17: 7. Solo entonces: el mínimo que funciona
 18: 
 19: **Nunca simplificar**: validación, manejo de errores, seguridad, accesibilidad o integridad de datos.
 20: 
 21: **Niveles de intensidad**: `/ponytail lite|full|ultra|off`. Default: `full`.
 22: 
 23: ## Estado actual
 24: 
 25: Aplicacion Laravel 13 con Livewire 4, Flux UI y Tailwind CSS 4 para gestionar clientes, citas y envios de WhatsApp. PHP 8.4. MySQL en produccion, SQLite para tests.
 26: 
 27: ### Stack tecnico
 28: 
 29: - PHP 8.4, Laravel 13, Livewire 4, Flux UI 2, Tailwind CSS 4
 30: - PHPUnit 12, SQLite in-memory para tests
 31: - Maatwebsite/excel para importaciones CSV
 32: - Twilio SDK para WhatsApp (driver principal)
 33: - Soft deletes en Client y Appointment
 34: - Phone normalization via trait `NormalizesPhone` (E.164)
 35: - Sunday validation via trait `ValidatesSelectableDate`
 36: 
 37: ### Arquitectura
 38: 
 39: - **Livewire-first**: las rutas apuntan a vistas Blade que montan componentes Livewire
 40: - **Service layer WhatsApp**: `app/Services/WhatsApp/` separa la logica de envio de los modelos
 41: - **Config-based templates**: las plantillas de WhatsApp viven en `config/whatsapp.php`, no en BD
 42: - **Traits compartidos**: `NormalizesPhone` (Client, WhatsAppMessage, WhatsAppSender), `ValidatesSelectableDate` (AppointmentForm, ClientMessageScheduler)
 43: 
 44: ### Modelos
 45: 
 46: | Modelo | Descripcion |
 47: |---|---|
 48: | `Client` | Pacientes. Soft deletes. Normalizacion de telefono. |
 49: | `Appointment` | Citas. Soft deletes. Campos: `activo`, `cita_activa`, `enviado`, `entregado`, `confirmada`, `pendiente_reprogramacion`. Timestamps: `whatsapp_sent_at`, `whatsapp_delivered_at`, `whatsapp_read_at`, `last_inbound_seen_at`. |
 50: | `WhatsAppMessage` | Mensajes WhatsApp. Campos: `direction` (outbound/inbound), `parent_id` (self-FK), `status` (pending/sent/failed), `respuesta`, `responded_at`, `provider_payload`, `metadata`. |
 51: | `WhatsAppTemplate` | Clase final (no Eloquent). Resuelve plantillas desde config. |
 52: | `AppointmentReminderPreference` | Preferencias de recordatorio por canal (whatsapp/email) y dias de anticipacion. |
 53: | `AppSetting` | Singleton unificado (fusion de `sistema_opciones` + `whatsapp_dispatch_settings`). |
 54: | `WhatsAppCredential` | Credenciales API en BD: `driver`, `account_sid` (encrypted), `auth_token` (encrypted), `webhook_enabled`, `poll_interval`. Fallback a .env. |
 55: | `TwilioContentTemplate` | Templates de contenido Twilio en BD. `content_sid`, `content_variables`. |
 56: | `User` | Usuarios. Campo `is_admin` para guard de administracion. |
 57: | `LoginHistory` | Registro de historial de login de usuarios. |
 58: 
 59: ### Componentes Livewire
 60: 
 61: | Componente | Funcion |
 62: |---|---|
 63: | `DashboardOverview` | Panel principal: total citas, pendientes, caducados, cancelados, enviados, fallidos |
 64: | `ClientList` | Listado y busqueda de clientes |
 65: | `ClientForm` | Crear/editar cliente |
 66: | `ClientMessageScheduler` | Programar WhatsApp desde ficha de cliente |
 67: | `ClientCsvImporter` | Importar clientes desde CSV |
 68: | `ClientAppointments` | Citas de un cliente: filtros, ordenacion, eliminacion masiva, reenvio, respuesta e historial |
 69: | `AppointmentList` | Listado general de citas con filtros y ordenacion |
 70: | `AppointmentForm` | Crear/editar cita con busqueda de cliente |
 71: | `AppointmentOverview` | Vista resumen de citas |
 72: | `DailyAgenda` | Agenda diaria con navegacion por fecha (hoy/manana) |
 73: | `WhatsAppConnectionTest` | Prueba de conexion WhatsApp en ajustes |
 74: | `AppointmentReminderSettings` | Configurar tiempos de envio, toggle envios programados, horas |
 75: | `TwilioContentTemplateSettings` | Gestionar templates de contenido Twilio |
 76: | `TwilioCredentialSettings` | Credenciales Twilio: modo sandbox/sender, API key, remitente |
 77: | `DispatchBanner` | Banner reactivo: aviso cuando envios automaticos deshabilitados |
 78: | `TableBackup` | Exportar/importar por tabla (clients, appointments, users) |
 79: | `SettingsBackup` | Exportar/importar ajustes del sistema |
 80: | `DatabaseBackup` | Exportar/importar base de datos completa |
 81: 
 82: ### Comandos Artisan
 83: 
 84: | Comando | Funcion | Programacion |
 85: |---|---|---|
 86: | `whatsapp:dispatch-due` | Encola y envia mensajes WhatsApp pendientes. Verifica `AppSetting.dispatch_enabled`. | 09:00, 12:00, 15:00 (con withoutOverlapping) |
 87: | `whatsapp:sync-delivery-status` | Sincroniza estado de entrega desde Twilio API | Cada minuto (sin overlap) |
 88: | `whatsapp:backfill-delivery-state` | Backfill de estados de entrega desde mensajes almacenados | Manual |
 89: | `settings:export` | Exporta ajustes a JSON | Manual |
 90: | `settings:import` | Importa ajustes desde JSON (v1 + v2) | Manual |
 91: 
 92: ### Servicios WhatsApp
 93: 
 94: | Servicio | Funcion |
 95: |---|---|
 96: | `WhatsAppSender` | Envia mensajes via Twilio/Cloud API/log. Modos: sandbox, sender, service, auto. |
 97: | `AppointmentImmediateSender` | Envio inmediato desde UI (dispatchSync para feedback al usuario) |
 98: | `AppointmentDeliveryStatusSyncer` | Sincroniza estados: via webhook Twilio, polling API, sync manual desde UI, e inbound responses |
 99: | `WhatsAppResponseHandler` | Procesa respuestas del cliente (3 estados: confirm*, otro payload, texto) |
100: 
101: ### Respuestas de WhatsApp (3 estados)
102: 
103: El sistema de matching de respuestas usa 3 estados:
104: 
105: 1. **Confirmada** — payload del botón empieza con "confirm" → verde, icono usuario-plus
106: 2. **Consultar** — cualquier otro payload → rojo, icono alerta
107: 3. **Sin cambio** — sin payload → usa campo de texto `respuesta`
108: 
109: - `responseStatusLabel()` en `Appointment` lee del último inbound message
110: - `WhatsAppResponseHandler::process()` crea registro inbound Y actualiza flags de la cita
111: - Inbound messages se almacenan con `direction=inbound` y `parent_id` apuntando al outbound original
112: - Quick Reply button clicks llegan via `/webhooks/twilio/whatsapp-inbound`
113: 
114: ### Historial de comunicaciones
115: 
116: - Cada respuesta es un registro SEPARATE en `whatsapp_messages` (no overwrite)
117: - Columnas: `direction` (outbound/inbound), `parent_id` (self-FK)
118: - Modal Alpine para ver historial completo
119: - Badge en columna `Respuesta` abre el historial
120: 
121: ### Backup / Import / Export
122: 
123: Accesible desde `/admin/tools`:
124: 
125: #### Por tabla
126: - Clientes, citas y usuarios: exportar JSON o CSV, importar JSON o CSV
127: 
128: #### Ajustes del sistema
129: - Configuracion de WhatsApp, recordatorios, plantillas, retencion de datos
130: - Exportar JSON o CSV ZIP, importar JSON (v1 + v2) o CSV ZIP
131: 
132: #### Base de datos completa
133: - Exportar JSON o CSV ZIP (una tabla por archivo CSV)
134: - Importar desde JSON o ZIP con CSVs
135: 
136: ### Rutas principales
137: 
138: | Ruta | Funcion |
139: |---|---|
140: | `/` | Home (redirige a dashboard) |
141: | `/dashboard` | Panel principal |
142: | `/agenda` | Agenda diaria |
143: | `/clients` | Listado de clientes |
144: | `/clients/list` | Lista de clientes (vista separada) |
145: | `/clients/create` | Crear cliente |
146: | `/clients/{id}/edit` | Editar cliente |
147: | `/clients/{id}/appointments` | Citas de un cliente |
148: | `/appointments` | Listado de citas |
149: | `/appointments/enviadas` | Citas enviadas (vista filtrada) |
150: | `/appointments/create` | Crear cita |
151: | `/appointments/{id}/edit` | Editar cita |
152: | `/admin/users` | CRUD de usuarios (admin) |
153: | `/admin/login-history` | Historial de login (admin) |
154: | `/admin/tools` | Herramientas: importar/exportar (admin) |
155: | `/admin/settings` | Ajustes de WhatsApp (admin) |
156: | `/admin/imports` | Importar CSV (admin) |
157: | `/admin/export/*` | Exportar CSV: clientes, citas, usuarios, base de datos |
158: | `/webhooks/twilio/whatsapp-status` | Webhook de estado de Twilio |
159: | `/webhooks/twilio/whatsapp-inbound` | Webhook de mensajes entrantes Twilio |
160: 
161: ### Webhook de Twilio
162: 
163: `POST /webhooks/twilio/whatsapp-status`
164: - Verifica firma de Twilio
165: - Sincroniza estado de entrega via `AppointmentDeliveryStatusSyncer::syncFromTwilioWebhook()`
166: 
167: `POST /webhooks/twilio/whatsapp-inbound`
168: - Procesa mensajes entrantes (Quick Reply button clicks)
169: - Usa `WhatsAppResponseHandler::process()` para crear registro inbound
170: - Fields: `ButtonText`, `ButtonPayload`, `ButtonType`, `Body`, `OriginalRepliedMessageSid`
171: 
172: ### Dashboard
173: 
174: Muestra 6 contadores:
175: - Total de citas
176: - Citas pendientes (futuras, activas, sin enviar)
177: - Citas caducadas (pasadas, activas, sin enviar, no entregadas)
178: - Citas canceladas (inactivas, sin enviar, no entregadas)
179: - Mensajes enviados
180: - Mensajes fallidos
181: 
182: ### Agenda diaria
183: 
184: - Vista por hora del dia
185: - Navegacion: hoy, manana, y hasta 10 dias (saltando domingos)
186: - Muestra incidencias: desactivada, sin enviar, no entregada, leida
187: 
188: ## Configuracion Twilio
189: 
190: Variables en `.env`:
191: 
192: ```env
193: WHATSAPP_DRIVER=twilio
194: TWILIO_WHATSAPP_MODE=auto
195: TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID=...
196: TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN=...
197: TWILIO_WHATSAPP_FROM=whatsapp:+14155238886
198: TWILIO_TEST_RECIPIENT=whatsapp:+34XXXXXXXXX
199: ```
200: 
201: Modos disponibles:
202: - `sandbox`: usa `TWILIO_WHATSAPP_FROM` (normalmente `whatsapp:+14155238886`)
203: - `sender`: usa un remitente real de WhatsApp configurado en Twilio
204: - `service`: usa `TWILIO_MESSAGING_SERVICE_SID`
205: - `auto`: prioriza Messaging Service si existe; si no, detecta sandbox; si no, usa sender
206: 
207: No guardar credenciales reales en este documento.
208: 
209: ## Comandos utiles
210: 
211: ```bash
212: # Arrancar todo junto
213: composer run dev
214: 
215: # Tests
216: php artisan test --compact
217: php artisan test --compact tests/Feature/ClientManagerTest.php
218: php artisan test --compact --filter=testName
219: 
220: # Formatear PHP (ejecutar despues de cualquier cambio en PHP)
221: vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent
222: 
223: # Frontend
224: npm run dev
225: npm run build
226: 
227: # WhatsApp
228: php artisan whatsapp:dispatch-due --no-interaction
229: php artisan whatsapp:sync-delivery-status --no-interaction
230: 
231: # Limpiar cache despues de cambiar .env
232: php artisan config:clear --no-interaction
233: ```
234: 
235: ## Pruebas relacionadas con WhatsApp
236: 
237: ```bash
238: php artisan test --compact tests/Feature/WhatsAppTwilioDispatchTest.php tests/Feature/WhatsAppConnectionTestComponentTest.php tests/Feature/WhatsAppDispatchCommandTest.php
239: ```
240: 
241: ## Pendientes
242: 
243: ### WhatsApp
244: 1. Registrar sender de WhatsApp en Twilio para usar templates custom en español con botones (error 63027 en sandbox).
245: 2. Resolver error 63112 (WABA deshabilitada) si persiste despues de registrar sender.
246: 
247: ### Correos
248: 3. Preparar plantilla de correo de WhatsApp.
249: 4. Preparar plantilla de correo de cita cancelada.
250: 5. Preparar plantilla de correo de cita reprogramada.
251: 6. Preparar plantilla de correo de cita confirmada.
252: 7. Preparar plantilla de correo de cita enviada.
253: 8. Preparar plantilla de correo de cita rechazada.
254: 9. Preparar plantilla de correo de cita rechazada por el cliente.
255: 10. Preparar plantilla de correo de cita rechazada por el dentista.
256: 11. Preparar para enviar correos de recordatorio de cita.
257: 12. Preparar para enviar correos de confirmacion de cita.
258: 
259: ### Funcionalidad
260: 13. Verificar entrega real de envios marcados como `queued` despues de 24h.
````

## File: README.md
````markdown
  1: # Citas Dentista
  2: 
  3: Aplicación Laravel para gestionar citas, pacientes y recordatorios por WhatsApp desde una sola interfaz.
  4: 
  5: ## Qué incluye
  6: 
  7: - Panel principal con métricas y próximos envíos
  8: - Gestión de pacientes y citas
  9: - Programación de mensajes de WhatsApp
 10: - Seguimiento de envío, entrega, lectura y respuestas de WhatsApp
 11: - Historial de comunicaciones por cita (badge en columna Respuesta)
 12: - Importación de datos desde Excel
 13: - Plantillas reutilizables para mensajes
 14: - Envío manual y envío programado
 15: - Pruebas automáticas para las partes principales del flujo
 16: - Backup e importación de ajustes (JSON + CSV ZIP)
 17: - Backup e importación de la base de datos completa (JSON + CSV ZIP)
 18: - Backup por tabla: clientes, citas, usuarios (JSON + CSV)
 19: 
 20: ## Stack
 21: 
 22: - Laravel 13
 23: - Livewire 4
 24: - Flux UI
 25: - Tailwind CSS 4
 26: - PHPUnit 12
 27: - Ponytail (lazy senior dev plugin for agents)
 28: 
 29: ## Requisitos
 30: 
 31: - PHP 8.4
 32: - Composer
 33: - Node.js y npm
 34: - Base de datos compatible con Laravel
 35: 
 36: ## Instalación
 37: 
 38: ```bash
 39: composer install
 40: npm install
 41: cp .env.example .env
 42: php artisan key:generate
 43: ```
 44: 
 45: Configura después la base de datos y el resto de variables en `.env`.
 46: 
 47: ## Arranque local
 48: 
 49: ```bash
 50: php artisan migrate
 51: php artisan serve
 52: npm run dev
 53: ```
 54: 
 55: Si prefieres un arranque completo del entorno:
 56: 
 57: ```bash
 58: composer run dev
 59: ```
 60: 
 61: Ese comando también levanta el scheduler de Laravel con `php artisan schedule:work`, así que las tareas automáticas quedan activas en local.
 62: 
 63: ## Pruebas
 64: 
 65: ```bash
 66: php artisan test --compact
 67: ```
 68: 
 69: Para una prueba concreta:
 70: 
 71: ```bash
 72: php artisan test --compact --filter=NombreDelTest
 73: ```
 74: 
 75: ## Flujo principal
 76: 
 77: 1. Crear o importar pacientes
 78: 2. Registrar citas o mensajes
 79: 3. Elegir una plantilla
 80: 4. Programar el envío
 81: 5. Revisar el estado y la respuesta desde la lista de citas
 82: 
 83: ## Respuestas e historial
 84: 
 85: En la lista de citas, la columna `Respuesta` muestra si el paciente confirmó (verde), pidió consultas (rojo) o envió un texto. Cuando hay respuesta, el badge abre el historial completo de comunicaciones de la cita. La columna de acciones queda reservada para enviar WhatsApp, editar y eliminar.
 86: 
 87: Tres estados de respuesta:
 88: - **Confirmada** (confirm*) — verde, icono usuario-plus
 89: - **Consultar** (cualquier otro payload) — rojo, icono alerta
 90: - **Sin cambio** (sin payload) — usa campo de texto
 91: 
 92: ## WhatsApp
 93: 
 94: La app soporta distintos drivers de envío mediante configuración. Revisa `config/whatsapp.php` y las credenciales asociadas en `.env` para dejar activo el canal que uses.
 95: 
 96: ### Auto-dispatch
 97: 
 98: El envío automático corre a las 09:00, 12:00 y 15:00 via `whatsapp:dispatch-due`. Usa lead_days configurados en `appointment_reminder_preferences`. Solo envía si la cita es futura, está activa y no ha sido enviada.
 99: 
100: ## Estructura útil
101: 
102: - `app/Livewire/`: componentes interactivos
103: - `app/Models/`: modelos de dominio
104: - `app/Services/WhatsApp/`: lógica de envío
105: - `database/migrations/`: esquema de la base de datos
106: - `tests/Feature/`: pruebas funcionales del flujo
107: 
108: ## Backup e Import/Export
109: 
110: Accesible desde `/admin/tools`:
111: 
112: ### Por tabla
113: - Clientes, citas y usuarios: exportar JSON o CSV, importar JSON o CSV
114: 
115: ### Ajustes del sistema
116: - Configuración de WhatsApp, recordatorios, plantillas, retención de datos
117: - Exportar JSON o CSV ZIP, importar JSON (v1 + v2) o CSV ZIP
118: 
119: ### Base de datos completa
120: - Exportar JSON o CSV ZIP (una tabla por archivo CSV)
121: - Importar desde JSON o ZIP con CSVs
122: 
123: ## Notas
124: 
125: - El proyecto usa Ponytail (`@dietrichgebert/ponytail`) para que los agentes escriban el mínimo código necesario — menos líneas, menos tokens, misma seguridad.
126: - Si cambias frontend, recuerda ejecutar `npm run dev` o `npm run build`.
````

## File: app/Livewire/Settings/TwilioContentTemplateSettings.php
````php
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Livewire\Settings;
  4: 
  5: use App\Models\AppSetting;
  6: use App\Models\TwilioContentTemplate;
  7: use Livewire\Component;
  8: 
  9: class TwilioContentTemplateSettings extends Component
 10: {
 11:     public string $nombre = '';
 12: 
 13:     public string $contentSid = '';
 14: 
 15:     public string $variablePreset = 'with_name';
 16: 
 17:     public string $status = '';
 18: 
 19:     public ?int $templatePendingDeletion = null;
 20: 
 21:     public string $appointmentReminderTemplateId = '';
 22: 
 23:     public string $appointmentCreatedTemplateId = '';
 24: 
 25:     public function mount(): void
 26:     {
 27:         $settings = AppSetting::get();
 28:         $defaultTemplateId = (string) (TwilioContentTemplate::query()->min('id') ?? '');
 29: 
 30:         $this->appointmentReminderTemplateId = (string) ($settings->twilio_template_appointment_reminder_id ?? $defaultTemplateId);
 31:         $this->appointmentCreatedTemplateId = (string) ($settings->twilio_template_appointment_created_id ?? $defaultTemplateId);
 32:     }
 33: 
 34:     public function addTemplate(): void
 35:     {
 36:         abort_unless(auth()->user()?->is_admin, 403);
 37: 
 38:         $data = $this->validate([
 39:             'nombre' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
 40:             'contentSid' => ['required', 'string', 'regex:/^HX[a-fA-F0-9]{32}$/', 'unique:twilio_content_templates,content_sid'],
 41:             'variablePreset' => ['required', 'in:with_name,appointment'],
 42:         ]);
 43: 
 44:         TwilioContentTemplate::query()->create([
 45:             'nombre' => $data['nombre'],
 46:             'content_sid' => $data['contentSid'],
 47:             'content_variables' => $this->variablePresets()[$data['variablePreset']],
 48:         ]);
 49: 
 50:         $this->reset('nombre', 'contentSid', 'variablePreset');
 51:         $this->status = 'Plantilla guardada.';
 52:         $this->dispatch('templateChanged');
 53:     }
 54: 
 55:     public function saveAssignments(): void
 56:     {
 57:         abort_unless(auth()->user()?->is_admin, 403);
 58: 
 59:         $data = $this->validate([
 60:             'appointmentReminderTemplateId' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'exists:twilio_content_templates,id'],
 61:             'appointmentCreatedTemplateId' => ['nullable', 'integer', 'exists:twilio_content_templates,id'],
 62:         ]);
 63: 
 64:         AppSetting::get()->update([
 65:             'twilio_template_appointment_reminder_id' => $data['appointmentReminderTemplateId'] !== '' ? $data['appointmentReminderTemplateId'] : null,
 66:             'twilio_template_appointment_created_id' => $data['appointmentCreatedTemplateId'] !== '' ? $data['appointmentCreatedTemplateId'] : null,
 67:         ]);
 68: 
 69:         $this->status = 'Asignaciones de plantillas actualizadas.';
 70:         $this->dispatch('templateChanged');
 71:     }
 72: 
 73:     public function deleteTemplate(int $templateId): void
 74:     {
 75:         abort_unless(auth()->user()?->is_admin, 403);
 76: 
 77:         $template = TwilioContentTemplate::query()->findOrFail($templateId);
 78:         $template->delete();
 79: 
 80:         if ((int) $this->appointmentReminderTemplateId === $templateId) {
 81:             $this->appointmentReminderTemplateId = '';
 82:         }
 83: 
 84:         if ((int) $this->appointmentCreatedTemplateId === $templateId) {
 85:             $this->appointmentCreatedTemplateId = '';
 86:         }
 87: 
 88:         $this->status = 'Plantilla eliminada.';
 89:         $this->dispatch('templateChanged');
 90:         $this->templatePendingDeletion = null;
 91:     }
 92: 
 93:     public function confirmDeleteTemplate(int $templateId): void
 94:     {
 95:         abort_unless(auth()->user()?->is_admin, 403);
 96: 
 97:         $this->templatePendingDeletion = $templateId;
 98:     }
 99: 
100:     public function cancelDeleteTemplate(): void
101:     {
102:         $this->templatePendingDeletion = null;
103:     }
104: 
105:     public function render()
106:     {
107:         $templates = TwilioContentTemplate::query()->orderBy('id')->get();
108: 
109:         return view('settings.twilio-content-template-settings', [
110:             'templates' => $templates,
111:             'pendingTemplate' => $templates->firstWhere('id', $this->templatePendingDeletion),
112:             'assignedAppointmentReminderTemplate' => $templates->firstWhere('id', (int) $this->appointmentReminderTemplateId),
113:             'assignedAppointmentCreatedTemplate' => $templates->firstWhere('id', (int) $this->appointmentCreatedTemplateId),
114:         ]);
115:     }
116: 
117:     /**
118:      * @return array<string, array<string, string>>
119:      */
120:     private function variablePresets(): array
121:     {
122:         return [
123:             'with_name' => ['1' => '[NOMBRE]', '2' => '[DIA]', '3' => '[HORA]'],
124:             'appointment' => ['1' => '[DIA]', '2' => '[HORA]'],
125:         ];
126:     }
127: }
````

 10: class TwilioCredentialSettings extends Component

 12:     public string $mode = 'sandbox';

 14:     public string $api_key_sid = '';

204:     public function testWebhook(): void
205:     {
206:         abort_unless(auth()->user()?->is_admin, 403);
207: 
208:         $credential = WhatsAppCredential::get();
209:         $callbackUrl = $credential->resolveStatusCallbackUrl();
210: 
211:         if ($callbackUrl === '' || $callbackUrl === null) {
212:             $this->status = 'No hay Callback URL configurada.';
213:             $this->dispatch('toast', message: 'Configura una Callback URL primero.', type: 'error');
214: 
215:             return;
216:         }
217: 
218:         try {
219:             $response = Http::timeout(10)
220:                 ->post($callbackUrl, [
221:                     'MessageSid' => 'SM'.strtoupper(bin2hex(random_bytes(16))),
222:                     'AccountSid' => $credential->resolveAccountSid() ?? '',
223:                     'From' => 'whatsapp:+34600000000',
224:                     'To' => 'whatsapp:+15559355880',
225:                     'Body' => 'Test webhook message',
226:                     'NumMedia' => '0',
227:                     'ButtonText' => 'Confirmar',
228:                     'ButtonPayload' => 'confirmarcita',
229:                     'WaId' => '34600000000',
230:                 ]);
231: 
232:             $body = $response->body();
233:             $statusCode = $response->status();
234: 
235:             if ($response->successful()) {
236:                 $this->status = "HTTP {$statusCode}\n".$body;
237:                 $this->dispatch('toast', message: "Webhook OK (HTTP {$statusCode})", type: 'success');
238:             } else {
239:                 $this->status = "HTTP {$statusCode} error\n".$body;
240:                 $this->dispatch('toast', message: "Webhook respondió HTTP {$statusCode}", type: 'error');
241:             }
242:         } catch (\Throwable $e) {
243:             $this->status = "Error: {$e->getMessage()}";
244:             $this->dispatch('toast', message: 'Error al conectar con el webhook.', type: 'error');
245:         }
246:     }
247: 
248:     private function validateCallbackUrl(string $url): ?string
249:     {
250:         if (str_contains($url, ' ')) {
251:             return 'La URL no puede contener espacios.';
252:         }
253: 
254:         $parsed = parse_url($url);
255: 
256:         if (! is_array($parsed) || empty($parsed['scheme']) || empty($parsed['host'])) {
257:             return 'La URL no es válida. Formato esperado: https://dominio.com/ruta';
258:         }
259: 
260:         if (! in_array($parsed['scheme'], ['http', 'https'], true)) {
261:             return 'El esquema debe ser http:// o https://.';
262:         }
263: 
264:         $host = $parsed['host'];
265: 
266:         if (strlen($host) < 3) {
267:             return 'El dominio de la URL es demasiado corto.';
268:         }
269: 
270:         if (! preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9]([a-zA-Z0-9\-]*[a-zA-Z0-9])?(\.[a-zA-Z0-9]([a-zA-Z0-9\-]*[a-zA-Z0-9])?)*\.[a-zA-Z]{2,}$/', $host)) {
271:             return 'El dominio de la URL no parece válido.';
272:         }
273: 
274:         $path = $parsed['path'] ?? '';
275:         if ($path !== '' && ! str_starts_with($path, '/')) {
276:             return 'La ruta de la URL debe empezar con /.';
277:         }
278: 
279:         return null;
280:     }
281: 
282:     public function render()
283:     {
284:         $credential = WhatsAppCredential::get();
285:         $pendingSenderNumber = collect($this->senderNumbers)
286:             ->firstWhere('id', $this->senderNumberPendingDeletion);
287: 
288:         $hasAuthToken = filled($credential->resolveAuthToken());
289: 
290:         return view('settings.twilio-credential-settings', [
291:             'credential' => $credential,
292:             'pendingSenderNumber' => $pendingSenderNumber,
293:             'apiKeySidLabel' => $hasAuthToken ? 'API Key SID (no necesario)' : 'API Key SID',
294:             'apiKeySecretLabel' => $hasAuthToken ? 'API Key Secret (no necesario)' : 'API Key Secret',
295:         ]);
296:     }
297: }

36:     private function refreshAlerts(?bool $dispatchEnabled = null): void
37:     {
38:         $settings = AppSetting::get();
39:         $credential = WhatsAppCredential::get();
40:         $currentHost = strtolower(request()->getHost());
41:         $currentUrl = request()->fullUrl();
42:         $callbackUrl = trim((string) ($credential->status_callback_url ?? ''));
43:         $callbackHost = strtolower((string) parse_url($callbackUrl, PHP_URL_HOST));
44:         $callbackScheme = strtolower((string) parse_url($callbackUrl, PHP_URL_SCHEME));
45:         $hasCallbackUrl = $callbackUrl !== '';
46:         $isLocalServer = app()->environment('local')
47:             || in_array($currentHost, ['localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1'], true)
48:             || str_ends_with($currentHost, '.test')
49:             || preg_match('/^(127\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+|10\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+|192\.168\.\d+\.\d+|172\.(1[6-9]|2\d|3[0-1])\.\d+\.\d+)$/', $currentHost) === 1;
50:         $callbackPointsToLocalHost = in_array($callbackHost, ['localhost', '127.0.0.1', '::1'], true)
51:             || str_ends_with($callbackHost, '.test')
52:             || preg_match('/^(127\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+|10\.\d+\.\d+\.\d+|192\.168\.\d+\.\d+|172\.(1[6-9]|2\d|3[0-1])\.\d+\.\d+)$/', $callbackHost) === 1;
53:         $hasWellConfiguredCallbackUrl = $hasCallbackUrl
54:             && in_array($callbackScheme, ['http', 'https'], true)
55:             && $callbackHost !== ''
56:             && ! $callbackPointsToLocalHost;
57: 
58:         $this->enabled = $dispatchEnabled ?? $settings->dispatch_enabled;
59:         $this->alerts = array_values(array_filter([
60:             ! $this->enabled ? [
61:                 'tone' => 'danger',
62:                 'title' => 'Envíos automáticos deshabilitados',
63:                 'message' => 'Los recordatorios automáticos de WhatsApp están apagados en la configuración.',

65:             ! filled($credential->resolveAccountSid()) ? [
66:                 'tone' => 'warning',
67:                 'title' => 'Falta TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID',
68:                 'message' => 'Twilio no podrá autenticarse correctamente hasta que se configure el Account SID.',
69:             ] : null,
70:             $isLocalServer && ! $hasWellConfiguredCallbackUrl ? [
71:                 'tone' => 'warning',
72:                 'title' => 'Servidor local detectado',
73:                 'message' => $hasCallbackUrl
74:                     ? "La aplicación se está sirviendo desde {$currentUrl} y la Callback URL guardada en base de datos ({$callbackUrl}) no parece pública o válida para Twilio."
75:                     : 'La aplicación se está sirviendo en local y la Callback URL guardada en base de datos está vacía.',
76:             ] : null,
77:         ]));

  5: use App\Models\Appointment;
  6: use App\Models\WhatsAppCredential;
  7: use App\Models\WhatsAppMessage;
  8: use App\Services\WhatsApp\AppointmentDeliveryStatusSyncer;
  9: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
 10: use Livewire\Component;
 11: 
 12: class UnreadResponsesNotice extends Component
 13: {
 14:     private AppointmentDeliveryStatusSyncer $deliveryStatusSyncer;
 15: 
 16:     public function boot(AppointmentDeliveryStatusSyncer $deliveryStatusSyncer): void
 17:     {
 18:         $this->deliveryStatusSyncer = $deliveryStatusSyncer;
 19:     }
 20: 
 21:     public function pollUpdates(): void
 22:     {
 23:         if (! $this->shouldSyncFromTwilio()) {
 24:             return;
 25:         }
 26: 
 27:         $this->deliveryStatusSyncer->syncAll(force: true);
 28:     }
 29: 
 30:     public function render()
 31:     {
 32:         $appointments = Appointment::query()
 33:             ->whereHas('whatsAppMessages', fn ($query) => $query
 34:                 ->where('direction', WhatsAppMessage::DIRECTION_INBOUND)
 35:                 ->whereNotNull('respuesta'))
 36:             ->with([
 37:                 'client',
 38:                 'whatsAppMessages' => fn ($query) => $query
 39:                     ->select([
 40:                         'id',
 41:                         'appointment_id',
 42:                         'direction',
 43:                         'message',
 44:                         'respuesta',
 45:                         'responded_at',
 46:                         'sent_at',
 47:                         'created_at',
 48:                         'provider_payload',
 49:                     ])
 50:                     ->orderByDesc('created_at'),
 51:             ])
 52:             ->get()
 53:             ->filter->hasUnreadInboundResponse()
 54:             ->sortByDesc(function (Appointment $appointment): int {
 55:                 $latestInbound = $appointment->latestInboundAfterLastSent();
 56: 
 57:                 return $latestInbound?->responded_at?->timestamp
 58:                     ?? $latestInbound?->created_at?->timestamp
 59:                     ?? 0;
 60:             })
 61:             ->take(5)
 62:             ->values()
 63:             ->map(function (Appointment $appointment): array {
 64:                 $latestInbound = $appointment->latestInboundAfterLastSent();
 65: 
 66:                 return [
 67:                     'appointment_id' => $appointment->id,
 68:                     'client_name' => $appointment->client?->full_name ?? 'Cliente',
 69:                     'response_badge' => $this->responseBadge($latestInbound),
 70:                     'responded_at' => $latestInbound?->responded_at ?? $latestInbound?->created_at,
 71:                     'client_url' => route('clients.appointments', $appointment->client_id),
 72:                     'url' => route('clients.appointments', [
 73:                         'client' => $appointment->client_id,
 74:                         'history' => $appointment->id,
 75:                     ]),
 76:                 ];
 77:             });
 78: 
 79:         return view('livewire.avisos.unread-responses-notice', [
 80:             'items' => $appointments,
 81:             'pollInterval' => WhatsAppCredential::webhookEnabled() ? 2 : WhatsAppCredential::pollInterval(),
 82:         ]);
 83:     }
 84: 
 85:     /** @return array{label: string, classes: string, icono: string}|null */
 86:     private function responseBadge(?WhatsAppMessage $message): ?array
 87:     {
 88:         if (! $message) {
 89:             return null;
 90:         }
 91: 
 92:         if ($message->isConfirmed()) {
 93:             return [
 94:                 'label' => 'Cita Confirmada',
 95:                 'classes' => 'bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-300 border border-emerald-400/30',
 96:                 'icono' => 'usuario-plus',
 97:             ];
 98:         }
 99: 
100:         if ($message->isRescheduleRequested()) {
101:             return [
102:                 'label' => 'Hay Incidencia',
103:                 'classes' => 'bg-red-500/15 text-red-300 border border-red-400/30',
104:                 'icono' => 'alert',
105:             ];
106:         }
107: 
108:         $label = $message->responseValue();
109: 
110:         if (! $label) {
111:             return null;
112:         }
113: 
114:         return [
115:             'label' => $label,
116:             'classes' => 'bg-sky-500/20 text-sky-200 border border-sky-400/40 ring-2 ring-sky-300/20',
117:             'icono' => 'ojo',
118:         ];
119:     }
120: 
121:     private function shouldSyncFromTwilio(): bool
122:     {
123:         $cacheKey = 'unread_responses_notice_twilio_synced_at';
124:         $lastSyncedAt = (int) Cache::get($cacheKey, 0);
125:         $now = now()->timestamp;
126: 
127:         if ($lastSyncedAt > 0 && $lastSyncedAt <= $now && ($now - $lastSyncedAt) < $this->twilioSyncInterval()) {
128:             return false;
129:         }
130: 
131:         Cache::put($cacheKey, $now, now()->addMinutes(5));
132: 
133:         return true;
134:     }
135: 
136:     private function twilioSyncInterval(): int
137:     {
138:         $credential = WhatsAppCredential::get();
139:         $interval = (int) ($credential->poll_interval ?? 10);
140: 
141:         return max(5, min(60, $interval));
142:     }
143: }
````

 1: <?php

 3: namespace App\Models;

 5: use App\Traits\NormalizesPhone;
 6: use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Casts\Attribute;
 7: use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
 8: use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
 9: use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;
10: use Illuminate\Support\Str;
11: 
12: class Client extends Model
13: {
14:     use HasFactory, NormalizesPhone;
15: 
16:     protected $fillable = [
17:         'nombre',
18:         'apellidos',
19:         'telefono',
20:     ];
21: 
22:     public function getFullNameAttribute(): string
23:     {
24:         return trim(implode(' ', array_filter([
25:             $this->nombre,
26:             $this->apellidos,
27:         ])));
28:     }
29: 
30:     public function messages(): HasMany
31:     {
32:         return $this->hasMany(WhatsAppMessage::class);
33:     }
34: 
35:     public function appointments(): HasMany
36:     {
37:         return $this->hasMany(Appointment::class);
38:     }
39: 
40:     protected function telefono(): Attribute
41:     {
42:         return Attribute::set(fn (string $value): string => static::normalizePhone($value));
43:     }
44: 
45:     public static function isValidPhone(string $phone): bool
46:     {
47:         $normalized = static::normalizePhone($phone);
48: 
49:         if ($normalized === '') {
50:             return false;
51:         }
52: 
53:         $digits = preg_replace('/\D+/', '', $normalized) ?? '';
54: 
55:         return strlen($digits) >= 7 && strlen($digits) <= 15;
56:     }
57: 
58:     public static function upsertFromImport(array $data): self
59:     {
60:         $rawPhone = trim((string) ($data['telefono'] ?? ''));
61:         $rawName = trim(implode(' ', array_filter([
62:             (string) ($data['nombre'] ?? ''),
63:             (string) ($data['apellidos'] ?? ''),
64:         ])));
65:         $normalizedPhone = static::normalizePhone($rawPhone);
66:         $payload = [
67:             'nombre' => trim((string) ($data['nombre'] ?? '')),
68:             'apellidos' => trim((string) ($data['apellidos'] ?? '')),
69:             'telefono' => $normalizedPhone,
70:         ];
71: 
72:         $lookupName = static::normalizeImportValue($rawName);
73: 
74:         $client = static::query()
75:             ->get()
76:             ->first(fn (self $candidate): bool => static::matchesImportIdentity($candidate, $normalizedPhone, $lookupName));
77: 
78:         if ($client) {
79:             return $client;
80:         }
81: 
82:         return static::query()->create($payload);
83:     }
84: 
85:     private static function matchesImportIdentity(self $client, string $lookupPhone, string $lookupName): bool
86:     {
87:         return static::normalizeImportValue(trim($client->nombre.' '.$client->apellidos)) === $lookupName
88:             && static::normalizePhone((string) $client->telefono) === $lookupPhone;
89:     }
90: 
91:     private static function normalizeImportValue(string $value): string
92:     {
93:         $value = Str::ascii(trim($value));
94:         $value = preg_replace('/\s+/', ' ', $value) ?? $value;
95: 
96:         return mb_strtolower($value);
97:     }
98: }

## File: app/Services/WhatsApp/WhatsAppResponseHandler.php
````php
 1: <?php
 2: 
 3: namespace App\Services\WhatsApp;
 4: 
 5: use App\Models\WhatsAppMessage;
 6: use Carbon\Carbon;
 7: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
 8: 
 9: class WhatsAppResponseHandler
10: {
11:     /**
12:      * Create an inbound response record and update appointment flags.
13:      */
14:     public static function process(WhatsAppMessage $outbound, string $responseText, array $inboundPayload = []): WhatsAppMessage
15:     {
16:         $messageSid = trim((string) data_get($inboundPayload, 'message_sid', ''));
17:         $receivedAt = data_get($inboundPayload, 'received_at', '');
18:         $twilioTime = $receivedAt !== '' ? Carbon::parse($receivedAt)->timezone(config('app.timezone')) : now();
19: 
20:         $inbound = WhatsAppMessage::query()->create([
21:             'user_id' => $outbound->user_id,
22:             'client_id' => $outbound->client_id,
23:             'appointment_id' => $outbound->appointment_id,
24:             'parent_id' => $outbound->id,
25:             'nombre' => $outbound->nombre,
26:             'apellidos' => $outbound->apellidos,
27:             'telefono' => $outbound->telefono,
28:             'scheduled_for' => $twilioTime,
29:             'message' => $responseText,
30:             'source' => WhatsAppMessage::SOURCE_APPOINTMENT,
31:             'status' => WhatsAppMessage::STATUS_SENT,
32:             'direction' => WhatsAppMessage::DIRECTION_INBOUND,
33:             'sent_at' => $twilioTime,
34:             'provider_message_id' => $messageSid !== '' ? $messageSid : null,
35:             'respuesta' => mb_substr($responseText, 0, 50),
36:             'responded_at' => $twilioTime,
37:             'provider_payload' => $inboundPayload !== [] ? ['inbound' => $inboundPayload] : null,
38:         ]);
39: 
40:         self::updateAppointmentFlags($inbound);
41: 
42:         return $inbound;
43:     }
44: 
45:     /**
46:      * Update appointment confirmada/pendiente_reprogramacion based on the inbound message.
47:      */
48:     public static function updateAppointmentFlags(WhatsAppMessage $inbound): void
49:     {
50:         $appointment = $inbound->appointment;
51: 
52:         if (! $appointment) {
53:             return;
54:         }
55: 
56:         if ($inbound->isConfirmed()) {
57:             $appointment->update([
58:                 'confirmada' => true,
59:                 'pendiente_reprogramacion' => false,
60:             ]);
61: 
62:             return;
63:         }
64: 
65:         if ($inbound->isRescheduleRequested()) {
66:             $appointment->update([
67:                 'pendiente_reprogramacion' => true,
68:                 'confirmada' => false,
69:             ]);
70: 
71:             return;
72:         }
73: 
74:         Log::info('WhatsApp response received (no action).', [
75:             'message_id' => $inbound->id,
76:             'appointment_id' => $appointment->id,
77:             'respuesta' => $inbound->respuesta,
78:             'button_payload' => data_get($inbound->provider_payload, 'inbound.button_payload'),
79:         ]);
80:     }
81: }
````

## File: AGENTS.md
````markdown
  1: # Citas Dentista — Agent Instructions
  2: 
  3: Laravel 13 app for dental appointment management with WhatsApp reminders. Livewire 4 + Flux UI + Tailwind CSS 4. PHPUnit 12. PHP 8.4. MySQL production, SQLite for tests.
  4: 
  5: ## Ponytail — Lazy Senior Dev
  6: 
  7: This project uses [`@dietrichgebert/ponytail`](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail) plugin (configured in `opencode.json`). Before writing any code, agents MUST apply the Ponytail ladder:
  8: 
  9: 1. **Does this need to exist?** → Skip if speculative (YAGNI)
 10: 2. **Already in this codebase?** → Reuse existing patterns/helpers
 11: 3. **Stdlib does it?** → Use built-in Laravel/PHP/Blade features
 12: 4. **Native platform feature?** → Use HTML/Livewire/Browser APIs first
 13: 5. **Installed dependency?** → Use Flux, Livewire, etc. — don't add new packages
 14: 6. **One line?** → One line
 15: 7. **Only then:** minimum code that works
 16: 
 17: **Never simplify away**: validation, error handling, security, accessibility, or data integrity.
 18: 
 19: **Intensity levels**: `/ponytail lite|full|ultra|off`. Default: `full`.
 20: 
 21: ## Commands
 22: 
 23: ```bash
 24: composer run dev          # full stack: server + queue + scheduler + pail + vite
 25: php artisan test --compact                              # all tests
 26: php artisan test --compact tests/Feature/ClientManagerTest.php  # single file
 27: php artisan test --compact --filter=testName           # single test
 28: vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent                 # format PHP (run after every PHP change)
 29: npm run build / npm run dev                             # frontend assets
 30: ```
 31: 
 32: ## Architecture
 33: 
 34: - **Models**: `Client`, `Appointment`, `WhatsAppMessage`, `WhatsAppTemplate`, `User`, `AppointmentReminderPreference`, `AppSetting`, `WhatsAppCredential`, `WhatsAppSenderNumber`, `TwilioContentTemplate`, `AppointmentChange`
 35: - **Livewire**: components in `app/Livewire/`, views in `resources/views/livewire/`
 36: - **Settings Livewire**: `AppointmentCleanupSettings`, `AppointmentReminderSettings`, `TwilioCredentialSettings`, `TwilioContentTemplateSettings`, `SettingsBackup` (settings import/export), `DatabaseBackup` (full DB import/export), `TableBackup` (per-table import/export)
 37: - **WhatsApp**: `app/Services/WhatsApp/WhatsAppSender.php` — drivers: `log` (default dev), `twilio`, `cloud_api`. Config at `config/whatsapp.php`. Twilio supports modes: `sandbox`, `sender`, `service`, `auto`.
 38: - **Imports**: Excel via `maatwebsite/excel`, preview in Livewire `ExcelImporter`
 39: - **Admin routes**: behind `admin` middleware, user management + security settings + tools
 40: - **Policies**: `ClientPolicy`, `AppointmentPolicy`, `WhatsAppMessagePolicy`, `UserPolicy`
 41: - **Jobs**: `SendWhatsAppMessage` (queued, `QUEUE_CONNECTION=database`)
 42: 
 43: ## Database
 44: 
 45: ### Tables (active)
 46: `users`, `clients`, `appointments`, `appointment_changes`, `whatsapp_messages`, `whatsapp_credentials`, `whatsapp_sender_numbers`, `twilio_content_templates`, `appointment_reminder_preferences`, `app_settings`, `login_history`, `password_reset_tokens`, `sessions`, `cache`, `jobs`, `job_batches`, `failed_jobs`
 47: 
 48: ### Settings tables
 49: - `app_settings` — single-row: `retention_period`, `dispatch_enabled`, `dispatch_hours` (merged from old `sistema_opciones` + `whatsapp_dispatch_settings`)
 50: - `appointment_reminder_preferences` — multi-row: channel + lead_days + enabled
 51: - `whatsapp_credentials` — API config with 5 encrypted fields (`account_sid`, `auth_token`, `api_key_sid`, `api_key_secret`, `cloud_api_access_token`) + `webhook_enabled`, `poll_interval`
 52: - `whatsapp_sender_numbers` — FK to `whatsapp_credentials`, cascade delete
 53: - `twilio_content_templates` — unique `content_sid`, JSON `content_variables`
 54: 
 55: ## Backup / Import / Export
 56: 
 57: ### Per-table (`/admin/tools`)
 58: - Export: JSON or CSV per table (clients, appointments, users)
 59: - Import: JSON or CSV, select target table, upsert by ID (or phone+name for clients)
 60: 
 61: ### Settings (`/admin/tools`)
 62: - Export: JSON or CSV ZIP
 63: - Import: JSON (v1 + v2 backward compat) or CSV ZIP
 64: 
 65: ### Full database (`/admin/tools`)
 66: - Export: JSON (all tables) or CSV ZIP (one CSV per table)
 67: - Import: JSON or ZIP with CSVs, FK order respected
 68: 
 69: ### Artisan commands
 70: ```bash
 71: php artisan settings:export {path?}    # export settings to JSON
 72: php artisan settings:import {path?}    # import settings from JSON (supports v1 + v2)
 73: ```
 74: 
 75: ## Conventions
 76: 
 77: - Spanish field names on models: `nombre`, `apellidos`, `telefono`, `fecha`, `hora`, `enviado`, `entregado`, `activo`
 78: - Phone normalization via `App\Traits\NormalizesPhone` trait (shared by `Client` and `WhatsAppSender`)
 79: - Blade components: `resources/views/components/iconos/`, `botones/`, `formularios/`, `navegacion/`
 80: - Routes are view-based for most pages (Livewire embedded in Blade views), except admin CRUD and webhooks
 81: - Livewire components registered manually in `AppServiceProvider` via `Livewire::component()`
 82: 
 83: ## Testing
 84: 
 85: - Tests use SQLite in-memory (`phpunit.xml` sets `DB_DATABASE=:memory:`)
 86: - Use factories for models; `UserFactory` exists, check for custom states
 87: - PHPUnit classes only — convert any Pest tests to PHPUnit
 88: - Test WhatsApp with `log` driver (default in `.env.example`)
 89: 
 90: ## Gotchas
 91: 
 92: - Run `vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent` after any PHP edit — CI expects formatted code
 93: - If you see `ViteException: Unable to locate file in Vite manifest`, run `npm run build`
 94: - `WHATSAPP_DRIVER=log` is the safe default — never hardcode Twilio/Cloud API credentials
 95: - `composer run dev` spawns 5 processes concurrently via `npx concurrently`
 96: - Database migrations are timestamped with `2026_06_*` and `2026_07_*` dates — newer files sort correctly
 97: - MySQL compatibility: never use `->after()` in `Schema::create()` (only works in `Schema::table()`)
 98: - MySQL compatibility: foreign keys in `Schema::create()` require the referenced table to already exist — check migration order or use `foreignId()->index()` without `constrained()` and add FKs later
 99: - Eloquent pluralizes model names for table lookup — set `protected $table` if the table name doesn't match
100: - Custom Blade components use Spanish names: `<x-iconos.whatsapp>`, `<x-botones.accion>`, `<x-formularios.input>`
101: - Livewire components are mounted via `<livewire:component-name>` in Blade views — routes point to views, not controllers
102: - Export/import JSON uses v2 format (app_settings as single table). Import supports v1 backward compat (sistema_opciones + whatsapp_dispatch_settings)
````

## File: app/Console/Commands/DispatchDueWhatsAppMessages.php
````php
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Console\Commands;
  4: 
  5: use App\Models\Appointment;
  6: use App\Models\AppointmentReminderPreference;
  7: use App\Models\AppSetting;
  8: use App\Models\WhatsAppMessage;
  9: use App\Services\WhatsApp\AppointmentDeliveryStatusSyncer;
 10: use App\Services\WhatsApp\WhatsAppSender;
 11: use Illuminate\Console\Command;
 12: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
 13: use Throwable;
 14: 
 15: class DispatchDueWhatsAppMessages extends Command
 16: {
 17:     protected $signature = 'whatsapp:dispatch-due';
 18: 
 19:     protected $description = 'Dispatch all due WhatsApp messages.';
 20: 
 21:     public function handle(WhatsAppSender $sender, AppointmentDeliveryStatusSyncer $deliveryStatusSyncer): int
 22:     {
 23:         try {
 24:             $settings = AppSetting::get();
 25: 
 26:             if (! $settings->dispatch_enabled) {
 27:                 $this->info('WhatsApp dispatch is disabled. Skipping.');
 28: 
 29:                 return self::SUCCESS;
 30:             }
 31: 
 32:             $queued = $this->queueActiveAppointmentMessages();
 33:             $count = 0;
 34: 
 35:             WhatsAppMessage::due()
 36:                 ->with('appointment')
 37:                 ->chunkById(100, function ($messages) use (&$count, $sender, $deliveryStatusSyncer): void {
 38:                     foreach ($messages as $message) {
 39:                         if ($message->appointment && ! $message->appointment->activo) {
 40:                             continue;
 41:                         }
 42: 
 43:                         try {
 44:                             $result = $sender->send($message);
 45: 
 46:                             $providerStatus = (string) data_get($result, 'raw.status', '');
 47:                             $isFailed = in_array($providerStatus, ['failed', 'undelivered'], true);
 48: 
 49:                             $message->update([
 50:                                 'status' => $isFailed ? WhatsAppMessage::STATUS_FAILED : WhatsAppMessage::STATUS_SENT,
 51:                                 'sent_at' => $isFailed ? null : now(),
 52:                                 'last_error' => null,
 53:                                 'provider_message_id' => $result['message_id'],
 54:                                 'provider_payload' => [
 55:                                     'provider' => $result['provider'],
 56:                                     'payload' => $result['payload'],
 57:                                     'raw' => $result['raw'],
 58:                                 ],
 59:                             ]);
 60: 
 61:                             if (! $isFailed && $message->appointment) {
 62:                                 $message->appointment->update([
 63:                                     'enviado' => true,
 64:                                     'whatsapp_sent_at' => now(),
 65:                                 ]);
 66:                             }
 67: 
 68:                             $deliveryStatusSyncer->sync([$message->appointment_id]);
 69:                         } catch (Throwable $throwable) {
 70:                             $message->update([
 71:                                 'status' => WhatsAppMessage::STATUS_FAILED,
 72:                                 'last_error' => $throwable->getMessage(),
 73:                             ]);
 74: 
 75:                             Log::channel('whatsapp_error')->error('WhatsApp send failed', [
 76:                                 'message_id' => $message->id,
 77:                                 'appointment_id' => $message->appointment_id,
 78:                                 'client_id' => $message->client_id,
 79:                                 'telefono' => $message->telefono,
 80:                                 'error' => $throwable->getMessage(),
 81:                             ]);
 82: 
 83:                             $this->error("Failed to send message {$message->id}: {$throwable->getMessage()}");
 84:                         }
 85: 
 86:                         $count++;
 87:                     }
 88:                 });
 89: 
 90:             $this->info(sprintf('Queued %d appointment message(s).', $queued));
 91:             $this->info(sprintf('Processed %d due message(s).', $count));
 92: 
 93:             return self::SUCCESS;
 94:         } catch (Throwable $throwable) {
 95:             Log::channel('whatsapp_error')->error('WhatsApp dispatch command failed', [
 96:                 'error' => $throwable->getMessage(),
 97:                 'trace' => $throwable->getTraceAsString(),
 98:             ]);
 99: 
100:             $this->error($throwable->getMessage());
101: 
102:             return self::FAILURE;
103:         }
104:     }
105: 
106:     private function queueActiveAppointmentMessages(): int
107:     {
108:         $queued = 0;
109: 
110:         foreach (AppointmentReminderPreference::enabledLeadDaysFor(AppointmentReminderPreference::CHANNEL_WHATSAPP) as $leadDays) {
111:             $targetDate = now(config('app.timezone'))->addDays($leadDays)->toDateString();
112: 
113:             Appointment::query()
114:                 ->with('client')
115:               // ->where('client_id', 1)
116:                 ->where('activo', true)
117:                 ->where('cita_activa', true)
118:                 ->whereDate('fecha', $targetDate)
119:                 ->chunkById(100, function ($appointments) use (&$queued, $leadDays): void {
120:                     foreach ($appointments as $appointment) {
121:                         $client = $appointment->client;
122: 
123:                         if (! $client || ! $client->telefono) {
124:                             continue;
125:                         }
126: 
127:                         if ($this->appointmentReminderExists($appointment, $leadDays)) {
128:                             continue;
129:                         }
130: 
131:                         $scheduledFor = $appointment->scheduledFor();
132: 
133:                         WhatsAppMessage::query()->create([
134:                             'client_id' => $client->id,
135:                             'appointment_id' => $appointment->id,
136:                             'nombre' => $client->nombre,
137:                             'apellidos' => $client->apellidos,
138:                             'telefono' => $client->telefono,
139:                             'scheduled_for' => now(),
140:                             'message' => WhatsAppMessage::buildMessage([
141:                                 'nombre' => $client->nombre,
142:                                 'apellidos' => $client->apellidos,
143:                                 'telefono' => $client->telefono,
144:                                 'scheduled_for' => $scheduledFor,
145:                             ]),
146:                             'source' => WhatsAppMessage::SOURCE_APPOINTMENT,
147:                             'direction' => WhatsAppMessage::DIRECTION_OUTBOUND,
148:                             'status' => WhatsAppMessage::STATUS_PENDING,
149:                             'metadata' => [
150:                                 'origin_appointment_id' => $appointment->id,
151:                                 'channel' => AppointmentReminderPreference::CHANNEL_WHATSAPP,
152:                                 'lead_days' => $leadDays,
153:                                 'twilio_template_scope' => WhatsAppSender::TEMPLATE_SCOPE_APPOINTMENT_REMINDER,
154:                             ],
155:                         ]);
156: 
157:                         $queued++;
158:                     }
159:                 });
160:         }
161: 
162:         return $queued;
163:     }
164: 
165:     private function appointmentReminderExists(Appointment $appointment, int $leadDays): bool
166:     {
167:         return $appointment->whatsAppMessages()
168:             ->get()
169:             ->contains(function (WhatsAppMessage $message) use ($leadDays): bool {
170:                 $metadata = $message->metadata ?? [];
171: 
172:                 return ($metadata['channel'] ?? null) === AppointmentReminderPreference::CHANNEL_WHATSAPP
173:                   && (int) ($metadata['lead_days'] ?? 0) === $leadDays;
174:             });
175:     }
176: }
````
