````php
340:     public function database()
341:     {
342:         abort_unless(DB::connection()->getDriverName() === 'sqlite', 501, 'La copia SQL solo está disponible para SQLite.');
343: 
344:         abort_unless(class_exists(ZipArchive::class), 500, 'ZipArchive no está disponible en este servidor.');
345: 
346:         $zipPath = tempnam(sys_get_temp_dir(), 'citas-backup-');
347:         abort_if($zipPath === false, 500, 'No se pudo crear el archivo temporal.');
348: 
349:         $zip = new ZipArchive;
350:         abort_if($zip->open($zipPath, ZipArchive::CREATE | ZipArchive::OVERWRITE) !== true, 500, 'No se pudo crear el ZIP.');
351: 
352:         $zip->addFromString('citas-dentista-backup.sql', $this->dumpSqliteDatabase(DB::connection()->getPdo()));
353:         $zip->close();
354: 
355:         return response()
356:             ->download($zipPath, 'citas-dentista-backup.zip', ['Content-Type' => 'application/zip'])
357:             ->deleteFileAfterSend(true);
358:     }
359: 
360:     private function downloadCsv(array $headings, array $rows, string $fileName)
361:     {
362:         $callback = function () use ($headings, $rows) {
363:             $handle = fopen('php://output', 'w');
364: 
365:             fputcsv($handle, $headings, ',');
366: 
367:             foreach ($rows as $row) {
368:                 fputcsv($handle, $row, ',');
369:             }
370: 
371:             fclose($handle);
372:         };
373: 
374:         return response()->stream($callback, 200, [
375:             'Content-Type' => 'text/csv',
376:             'Content-Disposition' => 'attachment; filename="'.$fileName.'"',
377:             'Cache-Control' => 'no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate',
378:             'Pragma' => 'no-cache',
379:             'Expires' => '0',
380:         ]);
381:     }
382: 
383:     private function downloadJson(array $data, string $fileName): Response
384:     {
385:         $json = json_encode($data, JSON_PRETTY_PRINT | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
386: 
387:         $path = storage_path("app/{$fileName}");
388:         file_put_contents($path, $json);
389: 
390:         return response()
391:             ->download($path, $fileName, ['Content-Type' => 'application/json'])
392:             ->deleteFileAfterSend(true);
393:     }
394: 
395:     private function dumpSqliteDatabase(PDO $pdo): string
396:     {
397:         $lines = [
398:             'PRAGMA foreign_keys=OFF;',
399:             'BEGIN TRANSACTION;',
400:         ];
401: 
402:         $tables = $pdo->query(
403:             "SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND sql IS NOT NULL AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name"
404:         )->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC);
405: 
406:         foreach ($tables as $table) {
407:             $lines[] = $table['sql'].';';
408:             $lines = array_merge($lines, $this->dumpSqliteTableRows($pdo, $table['name']));
409:         }
410: 
411:         $otherObjects = $pdo->query(
412:             "SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type IN ('index', 'trigger', 'view') AND sql IS NOT NULL AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY CASE type WHEN 'index' THEN 0 WHEN 'trigger' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, name"
413:         )->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_COLUMN);
414: 
415:         foreach ($otherObjects as $sql) {
416:             $lines[] = $sql.';';
417:         }
418: 
419:         $lines[] = 'COMMIT;';
420: 
421:         return implode("\n", $lines)."\n";
422:     }
423: 
424:     private function dumpSqliteTableRows(PDO $pdo, string $table): array
425:     {
426:         $columns = array_column(
427:             $pdo->query('PRAGMA table_info('.$this->quoteIdentifier($table).')')->fetchAll(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC),
428:             'name'
429:         );
430: 
431:         if ($columns === []) {
432:             return [];
433:         }
434: 
435:         $statement = $pdo->query('SELECT * FROM '.$this->quoteIdentifier($table));
436:         $rows = [];
437: 
438:         while ($row = $statement->fetch(PDO::FETCH_ASSOC)) {
439:             $rows[] = 'INSERT INTO '.$this->quoteIdentifier($table)
440:                 .' ('.implode(', ', array_map([$this, 'quoteIdentifier'], $columns)).') VALUES ('
441:                 .implode(', ', array_map(fn (string $column) => $this->quoteSqliteValue($pdo, $row[$column] ?? null), $columns))
442:                 .');';
443:         }
444: 
445:         return $rows;
446:     }
447: 
448:     private function quoteSqliteValue(PDO $pdo, mixed $value): string
449:     {
450:         if ($value === null) {
451:             return 'NULL';
452:         }
453: 
454:         if (is_bool($value)) {
455:             return $value ? '1' : '0';
456:         }
457: 
458:         if (is_int($value) || is_float($value)) {
459:             return (string) $value;
460:         }
461: 
462:         $quoted = $pdo->quote((string) $value);
463: 
464:         return $quoted !== false ? $quoted : "'".str_replace("'", "''", (string) $value)."'";
465:     }
466: 
467:     private function quoteIdentifier(string $identifier): string
468:     {
469:         return '"'.str_replace('"', '""', $identifier).'"';
470:     }
471: }
````

````php
209:     {
210:         $credential = static::get();
211: 
212:         return (bool) ($credential->webhook_enabled ?? true);
213:     }
214: 
215:     public static function pollInterval(): int
216:     {
217:         $credential = static::get();
218:         $interval = (int) ($credential->poll_interval ?? 10);
219: 
220:         if ((bool) ($credential->webhook_enabled ?? true)) {
221:             return 2;
222:         }
223: 
224:         return max(5, min(60, $interval));
225:     }
226: 
227:     private function stringSetting(mixed $value, string $configKey, string $default): string
228:     {
229:         $normalized = trim((string) $value);
230: 
231:         if ($normalized !== '') {
232:             return $normalized;
233:         }
234: 
235:         return (string) config($configKey, $default);
236:     }
237: 
238:     private function nullableStringSetting(mixed $value, string $configKey): ?string
239:     {
240:         $normalized = trim((string) $value);
241: 
242:         if ($normalized !== '') {
243:             return $normalized;
244:         }
245: 
246:         $fallback = trim((string) config($configKey, ''));
247: 
248:         return $fallback !== '' ? $fallback : null;
249:     }
250: 
251:     private function integerSetting(mixed $value, string $configKey, int $default): int
252:     {
253:         if (is_numeric($value)) {
254:             return (int) $value;
255:         }
256: 
257:         return (int) config($configKey, $default);
258:     }
259: }
````

## File: HANDOFF.md
````markdown
 1: # Handoff — Estado del Proyecto
 2: 
 3: ## Objective
 4: Gestionar clientes, citas y recordatorios WhatsApp para una clínica dental. Backup/import/export completo.
 5: 
 6: ## Ponytail
 7: 
 8: Este proyecto usa Ponytail (`@dietrichgebert/ponytail`). Ver `AGENTS.md` para la escalera completa. Nivel por defecto: `full`.
 9: 
10: ## Current state
11: 
12: Sistema completo funcionando. Últimas tareas:
13: - Response tracking simplificado a 3 estados (confirm*/otro payload/texto)
14: - Migraciones unificadas (add_xxx fusionadas en create_xxx)
15: - Backup/import/export: settings, per-table, full DB
16: 
17: ## Completed
18: 
19: ### Settings merge (6 → 5 tables)
20: - `sistema_opciones` + `whatsapp_dispatch_settings` → `app_settings`
21: - Export v2, import v1+v2 backward compat
22: 
23: ### Per-table export/import (`/admin/tools`)
24: - `TableBackup`: JSON + CSV per table, upsert por ID (clients: phone+name)
25: 
26: ### Settings export/import
27: - `SettingsBackup`: JSON + CSV ZIP, encrypted fields handled
28: 
29: ### Full database export/import
30: - `DatabaseBackup`: JSON + CSV ZIP, FK order respected
31: 
32: ### WhatsApp response tracking (3 states)
33: - `WhatsAppResponseHandler::process()`: creates inbound record + updates appointment flags
34: - `responseStatusLabel()` en `Appointment`: reads from latest inbound's `button_payload`
35: - Inbound webhook at `/webhooks/twilio/whatsapp-inbound`
36: - Quick Reply button clicks: `ButtonText`, `ButtonPayload`, `OriginalRepliedMessageSid`
37: - 3 states: confirm* → Confirmada (green); other payload → Consultar (red); no payload → text
38: 
39: ### Auto-dispatch
40: - `whatsapp:dispatch-due` at 09:00, 12:00, 15:00
41: - lead_days=1 enabled by default
42: - Deduplication via `appointmentReminderExists()` checking metadata.channel + lead_days
43: 
44: ## Files touched (key)
45: 
46: ### Models
47: - `app/Models/Appointment.php` — `responseStatusLabel()` (payload-first), `isFuture()` (date-only)
48: - `app/Models/WhatsAppMessage.php` — `isConfirmed()`, `direction`, `parent_id`
49: - `app/Models/AppSetting.php` — merged singleton
50: - `app/Models/WhatsAppCredential.php` — encrypted fields, `webhook_enabled`, `poll_interval`
51: 
52: ### Services
53: - `app/Services/WhatsApp/WhatsAppResponseHandler.php` — 3-state matching
54: - `app/Services/WhatsApp/WhatsAppSender.php` — drivers: log, twilio, cloud_api
55: - `app/Services/WhatsApp/AppointmentDeliveryStatusSyncer.php` — webhook, polling, inbound sync
56: 
57: ### Livewire
58: - `app/Livewire/Settings/TableBackup.php` — per-table export/import
59: - `app/Livewire/Settings/SettingsBackup.php` — settings export/import
60: - `app/Livewire/Settings/DatabaseBackup.php` — full DB export/import
61: 
62: ### Views
63: - `resources/views/livewire/appointment-list.blade.php` — Consultar red styling
64: - `resources/views/livewire/client-appointments.blade.php` — response badges, history modal
65: 
66: ### Tests
67: - `tests/Feature/TwilioWhatsAppStatusWebhookTest.php` — 7/7 passed (40 assertions)
68: 
69: ## Blockers
70: - None
71: 
72: ## Next steps
73: 1. Verify auto-dispatch in production (run `whatsapp:dispatch-due` manually)
74: 2. Test full flow: create appointment → send WhatsApp → receive response → verify badge + history
75: 3. Unify migration files (add_xxx → create_xxx) — COMPLETED
76: 4. Pending: email templates (items 3-12 in GUIA_RETOMAR_TRABAJO.md)
77: 
78: ## Notes for another computer
79: - Run `php artisan migrate` after pulling
80: - Run `php artisan view:clear` if stale component errors
81: - All Livewire components registered in `AppServiceProvider` — auto-discovery disabled
82: - Export routes: `admin.export.*` (clients, appointments, users, settings, all, database)
83: - Encrypted WhatsApp credentials: decrypted on export, re-encrypted on import
84: - `WHATSAPP_DRIVER=log` is safe default — never hardcode credentials
````

## File: app/Http/Controllers/Webhooks/TwilioWhatsAppStatusController.php
````php
  1: <?php
  2: 
  3: namespace App\Http\Controllers\Webhooks;
  4: 
  5: use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
  6: use App\Models\WhatsAppCredential;
  7: use App\Models\WhatsAppMessage;
  8: use App\Services\WhatsApp\AppointmentDeliveryStatusSyncer;
  9: use App\Services\WhatsApp\WhatsAppResponseHandler;
 10: use Illuminate\Http\Request;
 11: use Illuminate\Http\Response;
 12: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;
 13: use Twilio\Security\RequestValidator;
 14: 
 15: class TwilioWhatsAppStatusController extends Controller
 16: {
 17:     public function __invoke(Request $request, AppointmentDeliveryStatusSyncer $deliveryStatusSyncer): Response
 18:     {
 19:         if (! $this->isValidTwilioRequest($request)) {
 20:             Log::warning('Rejected invalid Twilio WhatsApp status callback.', [
 21:                 'message_sid' => $request->string('MessageSid')->toString(),
 22:                 'message_status' => $request->string('MessageStatus')->toString(),
 23:             ]);
 24: 
 25:             return response()->noContent(403);
 26:         }
 27: 
 28:         $payload = $request->all();
 29: 
 30:         if ($this->isInboundMessage($payload)) {
 31:             $this->processInboundMessage($payload);
 32:         } else {
 33:             $deliveryStatusSyncer->syncFromTwilioWebhook($payload);
 34:         }
 35: 
 36:         return response()->noContent();
 37:     }
 38: 
 39:     /**
 40:      * @param  array<string, mixed>  $payload
 41:      */
 42:     private function isInboundMessage(array $payload): bool
 43:     {
 44:         $direction = strtolower(trim((string) data_get($payload, 'Direction', '')));
 45:         $status = strtolower(trim((string) data_get($payload, 'Status', data_get($payload, 'MessageStatus', ''))));
 46:         $buttonText = trim((string) data_get($payload, 'ButtonText', ''));
 47:         $buttonPayload = trim((string) data_get($payload, 'ButtonPayload', ''));
 48:         $body = trim((string) data_get($payload, 'Body', ''));
 49: 
 50:         if (in_array($direction, ['inbound api', 'inbound-api', 'inbound_api'], true) && $status === 'received') {
 51:             return true;
 52:         }
 53: 
 54:         return $buttonText !== '' || $buttonPayload !== '' || in_array($body, ['Confirmar', 'Reprogramar'], true);
 55:     }
 56: 
 57:     /**
 58:      * @param  array<string, mixed>  $payload
 59:      */
 60:     private function processInboundMessage(array $payload): void
 61:     {
 62:         $from = trim((string) data_get($payload, 'From', ''));
 63:         $body = trim((string) data_get($payload, 'Body', ''));
 64:         $buttonText = trim((string) data_get($payload, 'ButtonText', ''));
 65:         $buttonPayload = trim((string) data_get($payload, 'ButtonPayload', ''));
 66:         $responseText = $buttonText !== '' ? $buttonText : ($buttonPayload !== '' ? $buttonPayload : $body);
 67:         $messageSid = $this->firstPayloadValue($payload, ['MessageSid', 'SmsMessageSid', 'SmsSid']);
 68:         $profileName = trim((string) data_get($payload, 'ProfileName', ''));
 69:         $parentSid = $this->firstPayloadValue($payload, ['ParentMessageSid', 'OriginalRepliedMessageSid', 'OriginalMessageSid', 'RepliedMessageSid']);
 70:         $conversationSid = $this->firstPayloadValue($payload, ['ConversationSid', 'ChannelSid']);
 71: 
 72:         Log::info('WhatsApp inbound message received.', [
 73:             'from' => $from,
 74:             'body' => $body,
 75:             'button_text' => $buttonText ?: null,
 76:             'button_payload' => $buttonPayload ?: null,
 77:             'message_sid' => $messageSid,
 78:             'parent_message_sid' => $parentSid ?: null,
 79:             'conversation_sid' => $conversationSid ?: null,
 80:         ]);
 81: 
 82:         if ($from === '' || $responseText === '') {
 83:             return;
 84:         }
 85: 
 86:         $phone = WhatsAppMessage::normalizePhone($from);
 87:         $message = $this->findMatchingMessage($parentSid, $phone);
 88: 
 89:         if (! $message) {
 90:             Log::info('No matching WhatsApp message found for inbound response.', [
 91:                 'phone' => $phone,
 92:                 'body' => $body,
 93:                 'parent_message_sid' => $parentSid ?: null,
 94:             ]);
 95: 
 96:             return;
 97:         }
 98: 
 99:         $inboundPayload = [
100:             'direction' => strtolower(trim((string) data_get($payload, 'Direction', ''))),
101:             'status' => strtolower(trim((string) data_get($payload, 'Status', data_get($payload, 'MessageStatus', '')))),
102:             'body' => $body,
103:             'button_text' => $buttonText !== '' ? $buttonText : null,
104:             'button_payload' => $buttonPayload !== '' ? $buttonPayload : null,
105:             'response_text' => $responseText,
106:             'message_sid' => $messageSid,
107:             'parent_message_sid' => $parentSid ?: null,
108:             'conversation_sid' => $conversationSid ?: null,
109:             'profile_name' => $profileName,
110:             'received_at' => now()->toDateTimeString(),
111:             'payload' => $payload,
112:         ];
113: 
114:         $inbound = WhatsAppResponseHandler::process($message, $responseText, $inboundPayload);
115: 
116:         Log::info('WhatsApp response recorded.', [
117:             'inbound_message_id' => $inbound->id,
118:             'outbound_message_id' => $message->id,
119:             'matched_by' => $parentSid !== '' ? 'parent_message_sid' : 'phone_latest',
120:             'parent_message_sid' => $parentSid ?: null,
121:             'phone' => $phone,
122:             'respuesta' => $responseText,
123:             'appointment_id' => $message->appointment_id,
124:         ]);
125:     }
126: 
127:     private function findMatchingMessage(string $parentSid, string $phone): ?WhatsAppMessage
128:     {
129:         if ($parentSid !== '') {
130:             $message = WhatsAppMessage::query()
131:                 ->where('provider_message_id', $parentSid)
132:                 ->where('status', WhatsAppMessage::STATUS_SENT)
133:                 ->where('direction', WhatsAppMessage::DIRECTION_OUTBOUND)
134:                 ->first();
135: 
136:             if ($message) {
137:                 return $message;
138:             }
139:         }
140: 
141:         return WhatsAppMessage::query()
142:             ->where('telefono', $phone)
143:             ->where('status', WhatsAppMessage::STATUS_SENT)
144:             ->where('direction', WhatsAppMessage::DIRECTION_OUTBOUND)
145:             ->latest('sent_at')
146:             ->latest('id')
147:             ->first();
148:     }
149: 
150:     /**
151:      * @param  array<string, mixed>  $payload
152:      * @param  list<string>  $keys
153:      */
154:     private function firstPayloadValue(array $payload, array $keys): string
155:     {
156:         foreach ($keys as $key) {
157:             $value = trim((string) data_get($payload, $key, ''));
158: 
159:             if ($value !== '') {
160:                 return $value;
161:             }
162:         }
163: 
164:         return '';
165:     }
166: 
167:     private function isValidTwilioRequest(Request $request): bool
168:     {
169:         $authToken = (string) (WhatsAppCredential::get()->resolveAuthToken() ?? '');
170:         $signature = (string) $request->header('X-Twilio-Signature', '');
171:         $callbackUrl = WhatsAppCredential::get()->resolveStatusCallbackUrl();
172: 
173:         if ($authToken === '' || $signature === '') {
174:             return true;
175:         }
176: 
177:         if ($signature === '') {
178:             return false;
179:         }
180: 
181:         $validator = new RequestValidator($authToken);
182: 
183:         $url = $callbackUrl !== '' ? $callbackUrl : $request->fullUrl();
184: 
185:         return $validator->validate($signature, $url, $request->all());
186:     }
187: }
````

````php
 41:

 43:             return;
 44:         }
 45:

 47:

 49:             now()->subDays(2),
 50:             now()->subDay(),
 51:         ])
 52:             ->reject(fn ($date) => $date->isSunday())
 53:             ->map(fn ($date): string => $date->toDateString())
 54:             ->all();
````

````php
250:

252:             ? (clone $clientsQuery)->count()
253:             : 0;
254: 
255:         $clients = $this->hasClientSearch
256:             ? $clientsQuery
257:                 ->orderByDesc('created_at')
258:                 ->limit(10)
259:                 ->get()
260:             : collect();
261: 
262:         return view('livewire.appointment-form', [
263:             'clients' => $clients,
264:             'selectedClient' => $this->selectedClient,
265:             'selectedAppointment' => $this->selectedAppointment,
266:             'isEditing' => $this->isEditing,
267:             'hideClientSearch' => $this->hideClientSearch,
268:             'canChangeAppointment' => $this->canChangeAppointment,
269:             'canSendAppointmentNow' => $this->canSendAppointmentNow,
270:             'showReturnAfterImmediateSend' => $this->showReturnAfterImmediateSend,
271:             'returnUrl' => $this->returnUrl,
272:             'hasClientSearch' => $this->hasClientSearch,
273:             'hasMoreThanTenClientResults' => $clientResultsCount > 10,
274:             'minimumSelectableDate' => $this->minimumSelectableDate(),
275:         ])->extends('layouts.app')->section('content');
276:     }
277: 
278:     protected function rules(): array
279:     {
280:         return [
281:             'selectedClientId' => [
282:                 'required',
283:                 'integer',
284:                 Rule::exists('clients', 'id'),
285:             ],
286:             'fecha' => ['required', 'date', Rule::date()->afterOrEqual('today')],
287:             'hora' => ['required', 'date_format:H:i'],
288:             'enviado' => ['boolean'],
289:             'activo' => ['boolean'],
290:             'sendImmediately' => ['boolean'],
291:         ];
292:     }
293: 
294:     protected function messages(): array
295:     {
296:         return [
297:             'fecha.after' => 'La fecha no puede ser anterior a hoy.',
298:         ];
299:     }
300: 
301:     private function sendAppointmentNow(
302:         Appointment $appointment,
303:         Client $client,
304:         WhatsAppSender $sender,
305:         string $successMessage,
306:         string $failureMessage,
307:         bool $showReturnAfterSuccess = false,
308:         string $templateScope = WhatsAppSender::TEMPLATE_SCOPE_APPOINTMENT_REMINDER,
309:     ): void {
310:         $result = $this->immediateSender->send($appointment, $client, $sender, $successMessage, $failureMessage, $templateScope);
311: 
312:         if ($result['sent']) {
313:             $appointment->refresh();
314: 
315:             $this->enviado = true;
316:             $this->showReturnAfterImmediateSend = $showReturnAfterSuccess;
317:         }
318: 
319:         session()->flash('status', $result['message']);
320: 
321:         $this->redirect(url()->previous());
322:     }
323: 
324:     private function minimumSelectableDate(): string
325:     {
326:         return now()->toDateString();
327:     }
328: 
329:     private function resolveReturnUrl(): string
330:     {
331:         $previousUrl = url()->previous();
332:         $currentUrl = url()->current();
333: 
334:         return $previousUrl !== $currentUrl
335:             ? $previousUrl
336:             : route('appointments.index');
337:     }
338: 
339:     private function loadAppointment(int $appointmentId): void
340:     {
341:         $appointment = Appointment::query()->with('client')->findOrFail($appointmentId);
342:         $this->deliveryStatusSyncer->sync([$appointment->id]);
343:         $appointment->refresh();
344: 
345:         $this->selectedAppointmentId = $appointment->id;
346:         $this->selectedClientId = $appointment->client_id;
347:         $this->returnUrl = route('clients.appointments', $appointment->client_id);
348:         $this->fecha = $appointment->fecha?->toDateString() ?? '';
349:         $this->hora = $appointment->hora;
350:         $this->enviado = (bool) $appointment->enviado;
351:         $this->activo = (bool) $appointment->activo;
352:     }
353: }
````

````php
  1: <?php

  3: namespace App\Services\WhatsApp;
  4: 
  5: use App\Models\Appointment;
  6: use App\Models\WhatsAppCredential;
  7: use App\Models\WhatsAppMessage;
  8: use Carbon\Carbon;

 11: use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Log;

 14: 
 15: class AppointmentDeliveryStatusSyncer
 16: {
 17:     public function syncAll(?int $clientId = null, bool $force = false): int
 18:     {
 19:         if (! $this->canSync()) {
 20:             return 0;
 21:         }
 22: 
 23:         $this->syncInboundResponses($clientId);
 24: 
 25:         $messages = WhatsAppMessage::query()
 26:             ->whereNotNull('appointment_id')
 27:             ->when($clientId, fn ($query) => $query->where('client_id', $clientId))
 28:             ->get(['id', 'appointment_id', 'provider_message_id', 'sent_at', 'created_at', 'provider_payload', 'metadata']);
 29: 
 30:         return $this->syncAppointmentsFromMessages($this->refreshMessages($messages, $force));
 31:     }
 32: 
 33:     public function backfillFromStoredMessages(?int $clientId = null): int
 34:     {
 35:         if (! $this->canSync()) {
 36:             return 0;
 37:         }
 38: 
 39:         $messages = WhatsAppMessage::query()
 40:             ->whereNotNull('appointment_id')
 41:             ->when($clientId, fn ($query) => $query->where('client_id', $clientId))
 42:             ->get(['id', 'appointment_id', 'sent_at', 'created_at', 'provider_payload', 'metadata']);
 43: 
 44:         return $this->syncAppointmentsFromMessages($messages);
 45:     }
 46: 
 47:     /**
 48:      * @param  iterable<int>|Collection<int, int>  $appointmentIds
 49:      */
 50:     public function sync(iterable $appointmentIds, bool $force = false): int
 51:     {
 52:         if (! $this->canSync()) {
 53:             return 0;
 54:         }
 55: 
 56:         $ids = collect($appointmentIds)
 57:             ->filter(fn (mixed $appointmentId): bool => (int) $appointmentId > 0)
 58:             ->map(fn (mixed $appointmentId): int => (int) $appointmentId)
 59:             ->unique()
 60:             ->values();
 61: 
 62:         if ($ids->isEmpty()) {
 63:             return 0;
 64:         }
 65: 
 66:         $clientIds = Appointment::query()
 67:             ->whereIn('id', $ids)
 68:             ->pluck('client_id')
 69:             ->unique()
 70:             ->values();
 71: 
 72:         foreach ($clientIds as $clientId) {
 73:             $this->syncInboundResponses($clientId);
 74:         }
 75: 
 76:         $messages = WhatsAppMessage::query()
 77:             ->whereIn('appointment_id', $ids)
 78:             ->whereNotNull('appointment_id')
 79:             ->get(['id', 'appointment_id', 'provider_message_id', 'sent_at', 'created_at', 'provider_payload', 'metadata']);
 80: 
 81:         return $this->syncAppointmentsFromMessages($this->refreshMessages($messages, $force));
 82:     }
 83: 
 84:     /**
 85:      * Persist a Twilio delivery callback and sync the related appointment state.
 86:      *
 87:      * @param  array<string, mixed>  $payload
 88:      */
 89:     public function syncFromTwilioWebhook(array $payload): int
 90:     {
 91:         if (! $this->canSync()) {
 92:             return 0;
 93:         }
 94: 
 95:         $messageSid = trim((string) data_get($payload, 'MessageSid', ''));
 96: 
 97:         if ($messageSid === '') {
 98:             return 0;
 99:         }
100: 
101:         $message = WhatsAppMessage::query()
102:             ->where('provider_message_id', $messageSid)
103:             ->first();
104: 
105:         if (! $message || ! $message->appointment_id) {
106:             return 0;
107:         }
108: 
109:         $providerPayload = $message->provider_payload ?? [];
110:         $providerPayload['callback'] = [
111:             'message_status' => strtolower(trim((string) data_get($payload, 'MessageStatus', ''))),
112:             'event_type' => strtoupper(trim((string) data_get($payload, 'EventType', ''))),
113:             'received_at' => now()->toDateTimeString(),
114:             'payload' => $payload,
115:         ];
116: 
117:         $message->update([
118:             'provider_payload' => $providerPayload,
119:         ]);
120: 
121:         return $this->sync([$message->appointment_id]);
122:     }
123: 
124:     /**
125:      * Query Twilio API for inbound messages and recover responses the webhook missed.
126:      */
127:     public function syncInboundResponses(?int $clientId = null): int
128:     {
129:         if (! $this->canSync()) {
130:             return 0;
131:         }
132: 
133:         $credential = WhatsAppCredential::get();
134:         $accountSid = trim((string) ($credential->resolveAccountSid() ?? ''));
135:         [$username, $password] = $this->twilioApiCredentials($credential);
136: 
137:         if ($accountSid === '' || $username === '' || $password === '') {
138:             return 0;
139:         }
140: 
141:         $sentMessages = WhatsAppMessage::query()
142:             ->where('direction', WhatsAppMessage::DIRECTION_OUTBOUND)
143:             ->where('status', WhatsAppMessage::STATUS_SENT)
144:             ->whereNotNull('provider_message_id')
145:             ->when($clientId, fn ($query) => $query->where('client_id', $clientId))
146:             ->get();
147: 
148:         if ($sentMessages->isEmpty()) {
149:             return 0;
150:         }
151: 
152:         $phoneGroups = $sentMessages->groupBy('telefono');
153:         $recovered = 0;
154: 
155:         foreach ($phoneGroups as $phone => $phoneMessages) {
156:             $twilioPhone = $phoneMessages->first()->twilioPhone();
157: 
158:             if ($twilioPhone === '') {
159:                 continue;
160:             }
161: 
162:             $inboundMessages = $this->fetchInboundFromTwilio(
163:                 $accountSid, $username, $password,
164:                 $credential, $twilioPhone
165:             );
166: 
167:             if ($inboundMessages->isEmpty()) {
168:                 continue;
169:             }
170: 
171:             $recovered += $this->matchInboundToOutbound($phoneMessages, $inboundMessages);
172:         }
173: 
174:         return $recovered;
175:     }
176: 
177:     private function twilioApiCredentials(WhatsAppCredential $credential): array
178:     {
179:         $apiKeySid = trim((string) ($credential->resolveApiKeySid() ?? ''));
180:         $apiKeySecret = trim((string) ($credential->resolveApiKeySecret() ?? ''));
181: 
182:         if ($apiKeySid !== '' && $apiKeySecret !== '') {
183:             return [$apiKeySid, $apiKeySecret];
184:         }
185: 
186:         return [
187:             $credential->resolveAccountSid(),
188:             $credential->resolveAuthToken(),
189:         ];
190:     }
191: 
192:     /**
193:      * @return Collection<int, array{sid:string,body:string,from:string,to:string,date_sent:string,direction:string}>
194:      */
195:     private function fetchInboundFromTwilio(
196:         string $accountSid,
197:         string $username,
198:         string $password,
199:         WhatsAppCredential $credential,
200:         string $twilioPhone,
201:     ): Collection {
202:         try {
203:             $response = Http::baseUrl('https://api.twilio.com')
204:                 ->acceptJson()
205:                 ->withBasicAuth($username, $password)
206:                 ->retry([100, 500, 1000])
207:                 ->timeout($credential->resolveTimeout())
208:                 ->connectTimeout($credential->resolveConnectTimeout())
209:                 ->get('/2010-04-01/Accounts/'.$accountSid.'/Messages.json', [
210:                     'From' => $twilioPhone,
211:                     'Direction' => 'inbound',
212:                     'PageSize' => 50,
213:                 ])
214:                 ->throw()
215:                 ->json();
216: 
217:             $messages = data_get($response, 'messages', []);
218: 
219:             return collect($messages)->filter(fn (array $msg): bool => strtolower(trim((string) data_get($msg, 'direction', ''))) !== 'outbound-api');
220:         } catch (Throwable $e) {
221:             Log::warning('Failed to fetch inbound messages from Twilio.', [
222:                 'error' => $e->getMessage(),
223:                 'phone' => $twilioPhone,
224:             ]);
225: 
226:             return collect();
227:         }
228:     }
229: 
230:     /**
231:      * Match inbound Twilio messages to outgoing WhatsAppMessages without a response.
232:      *
233:      * @param  Collection<int, WhatsAppMessage>  $outboundMessages
234:      * @param  Collection<int, array{sid:string,body:string,from:string,to:string,date_sent:string,direction:string}>  $inboundMessages
235:      */
236:     private function matchInboundToOutbound(Collection $outboundMessages, Collection $inboundMessages): int
237:     {
238:         $recovered = 0;
239:         $sorted = $outboundMessages->sortBy('sent_at')->values();
240: 
241:         $existingSids = WhatsAppMessage::query()
242:             ->where('direction', WhatsAppMessage::DIRECTION_INBOUND)
243:             ->whereNotNull('provider_message_id')
244:             ->pluck('provider_message_id')
245:             ->flip();
246: 
247:         foreach ($inboundMessages as $inbound) {
248:             $inboundDate = Carbon::parse(data_get($inbound, 'date_sent', ''))->timezone(config('app.timezone'));
249:             $body = trim((string) data_get($inbound, 'body', ''));
250:             $inboundSid = trim((string) data_get($inbound, 'sid', ''));
251: 
252:             if ($body === '' || $inboundSid === '') {
253:                 continue;
254:             }
255: 
256:             if ($existingSids->has($inboundSid)) {
257:                 continue;
258:             }
259: 
260:             $parentSid = trim((string) data_get($inbound, 'in_reply_to', ''));
261: 
262:             $matched = null;
263: 
264:             if ($parentSid !== '') {
265:                 $matched = $sorted->first(
266:                     fn (WhatsAppMessage $msg): bool => $msg->provider_message_id === $parentSid
267:                 );
268:             }
269: 
270:             if (! $matched) {
271:                 $matched = $sorted->filter(
272:                     fn (WhatsAppMessage $msg): bool => $msg->sent_at !== null
273:                         && $msg->sent_at->lte($inboundDate)
274:                         && $inboundDate->diffInSeconds($msg->sent_at) < 86400
275:                 )->sortByDesc(fn (WhatsAppMessage $msg): int => $msg->sent_at->timestamp)->first();
276:             }
277: 
278:             if (! $matched) {
279:                 continue;
280:             }
281: 
282:             $inboundPayload = [
283:                 'direction' => strtolower(trim((string) data_get($inbound, 'direction', ''))),
284:                 'status' => 'received',
285:                 'body' => $body,
286:                 'button_text' => null,
287:                 'button_payload' => null,
288:                 'response_text' => $body,
289:                 'message_sid' => $inboundSid,
290:                 'parent_message_sid' => $parentSid ?: null,
291:                 'conversation_sid' => null,
292:                 'profile_name' => '',
293:                 'received_at' => $inboundDate->toDateTimeString(),
294:                 'source' => 'twilio_api_sync',
295:             ];
296: 
297:             WhatsAppResponseHandler::process($matched, $body, $inboundPayload);
298: 
299:             $existingSids->put($inboundSid, true);
300: 
301:             $recovered++;
302:         }
303: 
304:         return $recovered;
305:     }
306: 
307:     /**
308:      * @param  Collection<int, WhatsAppMessage>  $messages
309:      * @return Collection<int, WhatsAppMessage>
310:      */
311:     private function refreshMessages(Collection $messages, bool $force = false): Collection
312:     {
313:         if ($messages->isEmpty()) {
314:             return $messages;
315:         }
316: 
317:         return $messages->map(function (WhatsAppMessage $message) use ($force): WhatsAppMessage {
318:             if ($this->messageWasRead($message)) {
319:                 return $message;
320:             }
321: 
322:             return $this->refreshMessageFromTwilio($message, $force);
323:         });
324:     }
325: 
326:     private function refreshMessageFromTwilio(WhatsAppMessage $message, bool $force = false): WhatsAppMessage
327:     {
328:         if (! $this->shouldPollTwilio($message, $force)) {
329:             return $message;
330:         }
331: 
332:         $credential = WhatsAppCredential::get();
333:         $accountSid = trim((string) ($credential->resolveAccountSid() ?? ''));
334:         $apiKeySid = trim((string) ($credential->resolveApiKeySid() ?? ''));
335:         $apiKeySecret = trim((string) ($credential->resolveApiKeySecret() ?? ''));
336:         $username = $apiKeySid !== '' && $apiKeySecret !== '' ? $apiKeySid : $accountSid;
337:         $password = $apiKeySid !== '' && $apiKeySecret !== ''
338:             ? $apiKeySecret
339:             : trim((string) ($credential->resolveAuthToken() ?? ''));
340:         $providerMessageId = trim((string) $message->provider_message_id);
341: 
342:         if ($accountSid === '' || $username === '' || $password === '' || $providerMessageId === '') {
343:             return $message;
344:         }
345: 
346:         try {
347:             $response = Http::baseUrl('https://api.twilio.com')
348:                 ->acceptJson()
349:                 ->withBasicAuth($username, $password)
350:                 ->retry([100, 500, 1000])
351:                 ->timeout($credential->resolveTimeout())
352:                 ->connectTimeout($credential->resolveConnectTimeout())
353:                 ->get('/2010-04-01/Accounts/'.$accountSid.'/Messages/'.$providerMessageId.'.json')
354:                 ->throw()
355:                 ->json();
356:         } catch (Throwable) {
357:             return $message;
358:         }
359: 
360:         if (! is_array($response) || $response === []) {
361:             return $message;
362:         }
363: 
364:         $providerPayload = $message->provider_payload ?? [];
365:         $providerPayload['provider'] = 'twilio';
366:         $providerPayload['raw'] = $response;
367:         $providerPayload['sync'] = [
368:             'source' => 'twilio_api',
369:             'received_at' => now()->toDateTimeString(),
370:         ];
371: 
372:         $updateData = ['provider_payload' => $providerPayload];
373: 
374:         $rawStatus = strtolower(trim((string) data_get($response, 'status', '')));
375: 
376:         if (in_array($rawStatus, ['failed', 'undelivered'], true) && $message->status !== WhatsAppMessage::STATUS_FAILED) {
377:             $updateData['status'] = WhatsAppMessage::STATUS_FAILED;
378:             $updateData['last_error'] = data_get($response, 'error_message')
379:                 ?: 'Twilio status: '.$rawStatus.' (error_code: '.data_get($response, 'error_code', 'N/A').')';
380:         }
381: 
382:         $message->update($updateData);
383: 
384:         return $message;
385:     }
386: 
387:     private function shouldPollTwilio(WhatsAppMessage $message, bool $force = false): bool
388:     {
389:         if ((string) data_get($message->provider_payload, 'provider') !== 'twilio') {
390:             return false;
391:         }
392: 
393:         if (! filled($message->provider_message_id)) {
394:             return false;
395:         }
396: 
397:         if ($this->messageWasRead($message)) {
398:             return false;
399:         }
400: 
401:         if ($force) {
402:             return true;
403:         }
404: 
405:         $messageAge = $this->messageAge($message);
406: 
407:         return $messageAge === null || $messageAge->greaterThanOrEqualTo(now()->subDay());
408:     }
409: 
410:     private function canSync(): bool
411:     {
412:         return Schema::hasColumn('appointments', 'entregado');
413:     }
414: 
415:     /**
416:      * @param  Collection<int, WhatsAppMessage>  $messages
417:      */
418:     private function syncAppointmentsFromMessages(Collection $messages): int
419:     {
420:         $groupedMessages = $messages->groupBy('appointment_id');
421: 
422:         if ($groupedMessages->isEmpty()) {
423:             return 0;
424:         }
425: 
426:         $appointmentIds = $groupedMessages->keys()->all();
427:         $appointments = Appointment::query()->whereIn('id', $appointmentIds)->get()->keyBy('id');
428: 
429:         $updated = 0;
430: 
431:         foreach ($groupedMessages as $appointmentId => $appointmentMessages) {
432:             $appointment = $appointments->get($appointmentId);
433: 
434:             if (! $appointment) {
435:                 continue;
436:             }
437: 
438:             $statusMessages = $appointmentMessages
439:                 ->reject(fn (WhatsAppMessage $message): bool => data_get($message->metadata, 'twilio_template_scope') === WhatsAppSender::TEMPLATE_SCOPE_APPOINTMENT_CREATED)
440:                 ->values();
441: 
442:             if ($statusMessages->isEmpty()) {
443:                 continue;
444:             }
445: 
446:             $sentAt = $this->latestTimestamp($statusMessages->map(fn (WhatsAppMessage $message): ?Carbon => $message->sent_at));
447:             $deliveredAt = $this->latestTimestamp($statusMessages->map(fn (WhatsAppMessage $message): ?Carbon => $message->deliveredAt()));
448:             $readAt = $this->latestTimestamp($statusMessages->map(fn (WhatsAppMessage $message): ?Carbon => $message->readAt()));
449: 
450:             $newEnviado = $appointment->enviado || $sentAt !== null;
451:             $newActivo = $newEnviado ? false : $appointment->activo;
452:             $newSentAt = $this->latestTimestamp(collect([$appointment->whatsapp_sent_at, $sentAt]));
453:             $newEntregado = $appointment->entregado || $deliveredAt !== null;
454:             $newDeliveredAt = $this->latestTimestamp(collect([$appointment->whatsapp_delivered_at, $deliveredAt]));
455:             $newReadAt = $this->latestTimestamp(collect([$appointment->whatsapp_read_at, $readAt]));
456: 
457:             $dirty = $newEnviado !== $appointment->enviado
458:                 || $newActivo !== $appointment->activo
459:                 || $this->timestampDiffers($appointment->whatsapp_sent_at, $newSentAt)
460:                 || $newEntregado !== $appointment->entregado
461:                 || $this->timestampDiffers($appointment->whatsapp_delivered_at, $newDeliveredAt)
462:                 || $this->timestampDiffers($appointment->whatsapp_read_at, $newReadAt);
463: 
464:             if ($dirty) {
465:                 $appointment->update([
466:                     'enviado' => $newEnviado,
467:                     'activo' => $newActivo,
468:                     'whatsapp_sent_at' => $newSentAt,
469:                     'entregado' => $newEntregado,
470:                     'whatsapp_delivered_at' => $newDeliveredAt,
471:                     'whatsapp_read_at' => $newReadAt,
472:                 ]);
473: 
474:                 $updated++;
475:             }
476:         }
477: 
478:         return $updated;
479:     }
480: 
481:     private function timestampDiffers(?Carbon $current, ?Carbon $new): bool
482:     {
483:         if ($current === null && $new === null) {
484:             return false;
485:         }
486: 
487:         if ($current === null || $new === null) {
488:             return true;
489:         }
490: 
491:         return $current->ne($new);
492:     }
493: 
494:     private function messageWasDelivered(WhatsAppMessage $message): bool
495:     {
496:         $callbackStatus = strtolower(trim((string) data_get($message->provider_payload, 'callback.message_status', '')));
497:         $callbackEventType = strtoupper(trim((string) data_get($message->provider_payload, 'callback.event_type', '')));
498:         $rawStatus = strtolower(trim((string) data_get($message->provider_payload, 'raw.status', '')));
499: 
500:         if (in_array($callbackStatus, ['delivered', 'read'], true) || $callbackEventType === 'READ') {
501:             return true;
502:         }
503: 
504:         return in_array($rawStatus, ['delivered', 'read'], true);
505:     }
506: 
507:     private function messageWasRead(WhatsAppMessage $message): bool
508:     {
509:         $callbackStatus = strtolower(trim((string) data_get($message->provider_payload, 'callback.message_status', '')));
510:         $callbackEventType = strtoupper(trim((string) data_get($message->provider_payload, 'callback.event_type', '')));
511:         $rawStatus = strtolower(trim((string) data_get($message->provider_payload, 'raw.status', '')));
512: 
513:         return $callbackStatus === 'read'
514:             || $callbackEventType === 'READ'
515:             || $rawStatus === 'read';
516:     }
517: 
518:     private function messageAge(WhatsAppMessage $message): ?Carbon
519:     {
520:         $timestamp = $message->sent_at ?? $message->created_at;
521: 
522:         return $timestamp instanceof Carbon ? $timestamp : null;
523:     }
524: 
525:     /**
526:      * @param  Collection<int, Carbon|null>  $timestamps
527:      */
528:     private function latestTimestamp(Collection $timestamps): ?Carbon
529:     {
530:         return $timestamps
531:             ->filter(fn (?Carbon $timestamp): bool => $timestamp instanceof Carbon)
532:             ->sortBy(fn (Carbon $timestamp): int => $timestamp->getTimestamp())
533:             ->last();
534:     }
535: }
````

````php
  3: namespace App\Models;

 20:     public const string STATUS_SENT = 'sent';

 24:     public const string SOURCE_MANUAL = 'manual';

 26:     public const string SOURCE_APPOINTMENT = 'appointment';
 27: 
 28:     public const string DIRECTION_OUTBOUND = 'outbound';
 29: 
 30:     public const string DIRECTION_INBOUND = 'inbound';
 31: 
 32:     protected $table = 'whatsapp_messages';
 33: 
 34:     protected $fillable = [
 35:         'user_id',
 36:         'client_id',
 37:         'appointment_id',
 38:         'parent_id',

 53:         'responded_at',
 54:     ];
 55: 
 56:     public static function buildMessage(array $data, ?string $template = null): string
 57:     {
 58:         Carbon::setLocale('es');
 59: 
 60:         $templateKey = $template ?: WhatsAppTemplate::defaultKey();
 61:         $template = WhatsAppTemplate::hasKey($templateKey)
 62:           ? WhatsAppTemplate::resolve($templateKey)['message']
 63:           : $templateKey;
 64:         $scheduled = $data['scheduled_for'] ?? null;

 66:         $replacements = [

138:     public function readAt(): ?Carbon

147:     public function isRead(): bool

152:     public function deliveryStatus(): string
153:     {
154:         $callbackStatus = strtolower(trim((string) data_get($this->provider_payload, 'callback.message_status', '')));
155:         $callbackEventType = strtoupper(trim((string) data_get($this->provider_payload, 'callback.event_type', '')));
156:         $rawStatus = strtolower(trim((string) data_get($this->provider_payload, 'raw.status', '')));
157: 
158:         if (in_array($callbackStatus, ['delivered', 'read'], true)) {
159:             return $callbackStatus;
160:         }
161: 
162:         if ($callbackEventType === 'READ') {
163:             return 'read';
164:         }
165: 
166:         if (in_array($rawStatus, ['delivered', 'read'], true)) {
167:             return $rawStatus;
168:         }
169: 
170:         return $rawStatus;
171:     }
172: 
173:     public function deliveredAt(): ?Carbon
174:     {
175:         if (! $this->isDelivered()) {
176:             return null;
177:         }
178: 
179:         $timestamp = data_get($this->provider_payload, 'callback.received_at')
180:           ?? data_get($this->provider_payload, 'sync.received_at');
181: 
182:         return $this->parseTimestamp($timestamp) ?? $this->sent_at ?? $this->created_at;
183:     }

185:     public function isDelivered(): bool
186:     {
187:         return in_array($this->deliveryStatus(), ['delivered', 'read'], true);
188:     }

190:     private function parseTimestamp(mixed $timestamp): ?Carbon
191:     {
192:         if (! is_string($timestamp) || trim($timestamp) === '') {
193:             return null;
194:         }
195: 
196:         try {
197:             return Carbon::parse($timestamp)->timezone(config('app.timezone'));
198:         } catch (Throwable) {
199:             return null;
200:         }
201:     }

204:     {

206:     }

208:     public function responseValue(): ?string
209:     {
210:         $direction = strtolower(trim((string) data_get($this->provider_payload, 'inbound.direction', '')));
211:         $status = strtolower(trim((string) data_get($this->provider_payload, 'inbound.status', '')));
212:         $responseText = trim((string) data_get($this->provider_payload, 'inbound.response_text', ''));
213:         $buttonText = trim((string) data_get($this->provider_payload, 'inbound.button_text', ''));
214:         $body = trim((string) data_get($this->provider_payload, 'inbound.body', ''));
215: 
216:         if (in_array($direction, ['inbound api', 'inbound-api', 'inbound_api'], true) && $status === 'received' && $body !== '') {
217:             return $body;
218:         }
219: 
220:         if ($responseText !== '') {
221:             return $responseText;
222:         }
223: 
224:         if ($buttonText !== '') {
225:             return $buttonText;
226:         }
227: 
228:         if ($body !== '') {
229:             return $body;
230:         }
231: 
232:         if (filled($this->message)) {
233:             return $this->message;
234:         }
235: 
236:         if (filled($this->respuesta)) {
237:             return $this->respuesta;
238:         }
239: 
240:         return null;
241:     }
242: 
243:     public function isConfirmed(): bool
244:     {
245:         $buttonPayload = strtolower(trim((string) data_get($this->provider_payload, 'inbound.button_payload', '')));
246: 
247:         if ($buttonPayload !== '') {
248:             return str_starts_with($buttonPayload, 'confirm');
249:         }
250: 
251:         $response = $this->normalizedInboundResponse();
252: 
253:         return $response !== ''
254:           && (
255:               str_contains($response, 'confirm')
256:               || in_array($response, ['confirmada', 'confirmado'], true)
257:           );
258:     }
259: 
260:     private function normalizedInboundResponse(): string
261:     {
262:         $responseText = trim((string) data_get($this->provider_payload, 'inbound.response_text', ''));
263:         $buttonText = trim((string) data_get($this->provider_payload, 'inbound.button_text', ''));
264:         $body = trim((string) data_get($this->provider_payload, 'inbound.body', ''));
265:         $respuesta = trim((string) $this->respuesta);
266:         $value = $responseText !== '' ? $responseText : ($buttonText !== '' ? $buttonText : ($body !== '' ? $body : $respuesta));
267: 
268:         $value = strtolower($value);
269:         $value = preg_replace('/\s+/u', ' ', $value) ?? $value;
270: 
271:         return trim($value, " \t\n\r\0\x0B:;,.!?-_+*#\"'()[]{}");
272:     }
273: 
274:     public function isRescheduleRequested(): bool
275:     {
276:         $buttonPayload = strtolower(trim((string) data_get($this->provider_payload, 'inbound.button_payload', '')));
277: 
278:         if ($buttonPayload !== '') {
279:             return str_starts_with($buttonPayload, 'reprogram') || str_starts_with($buttonPayload, 'cambiar');
280:         }
281: 
282:         $response = $this->normalizedInboundResponse();
283: 
284:         return $response !== ''
285:           && (
286:               str_contains($response, 'reprogram')
287:               || str_contains($response, 'cambiar')
288:           );
289:     }

291:     public function scopeResponded($query)
292:     {
293:         return $query->whereNotNull('respuesta');
294:     }

301:     public function twilioPhone(): string
302:     {
303:         $normalized = static::normalizeInternationalPhone((string) $this->telefono);
304: 
305:         return $normalized !== '' ? 'whatsapp:'.$normalized : '';
306:     }

308:     protected function casts(): array
309:     {
310:         return [
311:             'scheduled_for' => 'datetime',
312:             'sent_at' => 'datetime',
313:             'provider_payload' => 'array',
314:             'metadata' => 'array',
315:             'responded_at' => 'datetime',
316:         ];

325:     {
326:         return Attribute::get(fn () => $this->scheduled_for?->timezone(config('app.timezone'))?->format('d/m/Y H:i'));
327:     }
328: }
````

````php
349:             return;

351: 
352:         $data = $this->validate([

372: 
373:         $message = WhatsAppMessage::query()->create([
374:             'user_id' => Auth::id(),

383:             'source' => WhatsAppMessage::SOURCE_MANUAL,
384:             'direction' => WhatsAppMessage::DIRECTION_OUTBOUND,
385:             'status' => WhatsAppMessage::STATUS_PENDING,

392:

396:

398:             $this->historyReplyBody = '';

400:             $this->dispatch('toast', message: 'Respuesta enviada correctamente.', type: 'success');
401: 
402:             return;

404: 
405:         $this->refreshHistoryAppointment();
406:         $this->dispatch('toast', message: 'No se pudo enviar la respuesta. '.($message->last_error ?? ''), type: 'error');

409:     public function syncDeliveryStatuses(): void
410:     {
411:         $updated = $this->deliveryStatusSyncer->syncAll($this->clientId, force: true);
412:         $this->touchDeliveryStatusesSyncedAt();
413:         $this->refreshHistoryAppointment();
414: 
415:         if ($updated > 0) {
416:             $this->dispatch('toast', message: $updated === 1 ? 'Se ha actualizado 1 cita' : 'Se han actualizado '.$updated.' citas', type: 'success');
417: 
418:             return;
419:         }
420: 
421:         $this->dispatch('toast', message: 'Todos los registros de citas y demás datos están actualizados.', type: 'success');
422:     }
423: 
424:     public function autoSync(): void
425:     {
426:         if (! WhatsAppCredential::webhookEnabled()) {
427:             $this->deliveryStatusSyncer->syncAll($this->clientId, force: true);
428:         }
429: 
430:         $this->touchDeliveryStatusesSyncedAt();
431:         $this->refreshHistoryAppointment();
432:     }
433: 
434:     private function queuePageReloadAfterWhatsAppSend(): void
435:     {
436:         $this->dispatch('reload-appointment-list');
437:     }
438: 
439:     private function touchDeliveryStatusesSyncedAt(): void
440:     {
441:         $this->deliveryStatusesSyncedAt = now(config('app.timezone'))->format('H:i - d/m/Y');
442:         Cache::forever('appointment_delivery_statuses_synced_at', $this->deliveryStatusesSyncedAt);
443:     }
444: 
445:     private function refreshHistoryAppointment(): void
446:     {
447:         if (! $this->historyAppointment?->id) {
448:             return;
449:         }
450: 
451:         $this->historyAppointment = Appointment::query()
452:             ->with([
453:                 'changes',
454:                 'whatsAppMessages' => fn ($q) => $q->orderByRaw('COALESCE(sent_at, responded_at, created_at) asc')->orderBy('id', 'asc'),
455:             ])
456:             ->find($this->historyAppointment->id);
457:     }
458: 
459:     public function render()
460:     {
461:         $selectedClient = Client::query()->find($this->clientId);
462:         $appointmentsQuery = $this->appointmentsQuery($selectedClient);
463: 
464:         $appointments = $appointmentsQuery->paginate(30, ['appointments.*'], 'appointmentsPage');
465: 
466:         $visibleAppointmentIds = $appointments->getCollection()->pluck('id')->all();
467:         $allVisibleAppointmentsSelected = $visibleAppointmentIds !== []
468:           && array_diff($visibleAppointmentIds, array_map('intval', $this->selectedAppointmentIds)) === [];
469: 
470:         $appointmentPendingDeletion = $this->appointmentPendingDeletionId
471:           ? Appointment::query()->with('client')->find($this->appointmentPendingDeletionId)
472:           : null;
473: 
474:         return view('livewire.client-appointments', [
475:             'appointments' => $appointments,
476:             'appointmentsCount' => $appointments->total(),
477:             'appointmentPendingDeletion' => $appointmentPendingDeletion,
478:             'selectedClient' => $selectedClient,
479:             'showBulkActions' => true,
480:             'visibleAppointmentIds' => $visibleAppointmentIds,
481:             'allVisibleAppointmentsSelected' => $allVisibleAppointmentsSelected,
482:             'pollInterval' => WhatsAppCredential::pollInterval(),
483:         ])->extends('layouts.app')->section('content');
484:     }
485: 
486:     private function appointmentsQuery(Client $selectedClient): Builder
487:     {
488:         $now = now(config('app.timezone'));
489: 
490:         return Appointment::query()
491:             ->select('appointments.*')
492:             ->withCount('changes')
493:             ->with([
494:                 'client',
495:                 'latestWhatsAppMessage',
496:                 'latestRespondedWhatsAppMessage',
497:                 'whatsAppMessages',
498:             ])
499:             ->leftJoin('clients', 'clients.id', '=', 'appointments.client_id')
500:             ->where('appointments.client_id', $selectedClient->id)
501:             ->when($this->filter === 'upcoming', fn ($q) => $q
502:                 ->whereDate('fecha', '>=', $now->toDateString())
503:             )
504:             ->when($this->filter === 'past', fn ($q) => $q
505:                 ->whereDate('fecha', '<', $now->toDateString())
506:             )
507:             ->when($this->whatsappFilter === 'sent', fn ($q) => $q->where('enviado', true))
508:             ->when($this->whatsappFilter === 'delivered', fn ($q) => $q->where('entregado', true))
509:             ->when($this->whatsappFilter === 'unsent', fn ($q) => $q
510:                 ->where('appointments.enviado', false)
511:                 ->where('appointments.activo', false)
512:             )
513:             ->orderBy('appointments.fecha', $this->sort_direction)
514:             ->orderBy('appointments.hora', $this->sort_direction);
515:     }
516: 
517:     private function redirectAfterAction(string $status): void
518:     {
519:         $client = Client::query()->find($this->clientId);
520: 
521:         if (! $this->appointmentsQuery($client)->exists()) {
522:             session()->flash('status', 'No hay citas para el cliente '.$client->full_name);
523:             $this->redirect(route('appointments.index'));
524: 
525:             return;
526:         }
527: 
528:         session()->flash('status', $status);
529:         $this->redirect(route('clients.appointments', $client));
530:     }
531: }
````

````php
102:         $payload = [
103:             'to' => $recipient,
104:             'body' => $body,
105:         ];
106:

108:             'provider' => 'log',

110:             'message' => $body,
111:         ]);
112: 
113:         return [
114:             'provider' => 'log',
115:             'message_id' => null,

127:             $message->telefono,

134:     /**
135:      * @return array{provider:string,message_id:?string,payload:array,raw:array}
136:      */
137:     private function sendTestViaTwilio(string $recipient, string $body, ?string $mode = null, bool $forceTemplate = false, ?int $templateId = null): array
138:     {
139:         if ($forceTemplate) {
140:             return $this->sendTwilioRequest(
141:                 $recipient,

143:                 $mode,
144:                 $forceTemplate,
145:                 $templateId,
146:                 $this->buildFakeTemplateMessage($recipient, $body),
147:             );

153:     /**
154:      * @return array{provider:string,message_id:?string,payload:array,raw:array}
155:      */
156:     private function sendTwilioRequest(
157:         string $recipient,
158:         string $body,
159:         ?string $mode = null,
160:         bool $forceTemplate = false,
161:         ?int $templateId = null,
162:         ?WhatsAppMessage $message = null,
163:     ): array {
164:         $credential = WhatsAppCredential::get();
165:         $accountSid = $credential->resolveAccountSid();
166:         [$username, $password] = $this->twilioApiCredentials($credential);
167: 
168:         if (! $accountSid || ! $username || ! $password) {
169:             throw new RuntimeException('Twilio credentials are not configured.');
170:         }
171: 
172:         [$payload, $requestPayload] = $this->buildTwilioPayload($recipient, $body, $mode, $message, true, $forceTemplate, $templateId);
173: 
174:         $response = Http::baseUrl('https://api.twilio.com')
175:             ->acceptJson()
176:             ->asForm()
177:             ->withBasicAuth($username, $password)
178:             ->retry([100, 500, 1000])
179:             ->timeout($credential->resolveTimeout())
180:             ->connectTimeout($credential->resolveConnectTimeout())
181:             ->post('/2010-04-01/Accounts/'.$accountSid.'/Messages.json', $requestPayload)
182:             ->throw()
183:             ->json();
184: 
185:         return [
186:             'provider' => 'twilio',
187:             'message_id' => data_get($response, 'sid'),
188:             'payload' => $payload,
189:             'raw' => $response,
190:         ];
191:     }
192: 
193:     /**
194:      * @return array{0:?string,1:?string}
195:      */
196:     private function twilioApiCredentials(WhatsAppCredential $credential): array
197:     {
198:         $dbApiKeySid = $credential->resolveApiKeySid();
199:         $dbApiKeySecret = $credential->resolveApiKeySecret();
200: 
201:         // Primero intenta API Key/Secret; si no existen, cae a Account SID/Auth Token.
202:         if (filled($dbApiKeySid) && filled($dbApiKeySecret)) {
203:             return [$dbApiKeySid, $dbApiKeySecret];
204:         }
205: 
206:         return [$credential->resolveAccountSid(), $credential->resolveAuthToken()];
207:     }
208: 
209:     /**
210:      * @return array<string, mixed>
211:      */
212:     public function buildTwilioPreviewRequest(string $recipient, string $body, ?string $mode = null, bool $forceTemplate = false, ?int $templateId = null): array
213:     {
214:         return $this->buildTwilioPayload($recipient, $body, $mode, null, false, $forceTemplate, $templateId)[1];
215:     }
216: 
217:     /**
218:      * @return array{0:array,1:array}
219:      */
220:     private function buildTwilioPayload(
221:         string $recipient,
222:         string $body,
223:         ?string $mode = null,
224:         ?WhatsAppMessage $message = null,
225:         bool $validateConfiguration = true,
226:         bool $forceTemplate = false,
227:         ?int $templateId = null,
228:     ): array {
229:         $credential = WhatsAppCredential::get();
230:         $from = $credential->resolveFrom();
231:         $scope = $this->twilioTemplateScope($message);
232:         $template = $this->twilioContentTemplate($templateId, $scope);
233:         $contentSid = $template?->content_sid ?: $this->twilioContentSid($scope);
234:         $resolvedMode = $this->resolveTwilioMode($mode);
235:         $usesTemplate = $forceTemplate;
236: 
237:         if ($validateConfiguration && in_array($resolvedMode, [self::TWILIO_SANDBOX_MODE, self::TWILIO_SENDER_MODE], true) && ! $from) {
238:             throw new RuntimeException('Twilio WhatsApp sender is not configured.');
239:         }
240: 
241:         if ($validateConfiguration && $usesTemplate && ! $contentSid) {
242:             throw new RuntimeException('No hay una plantilla de Twilio disponible para este envío. Configura la asignación correspondiente en ajustes o usa un TWILIO_CONTENT_SID como respaldo.');
243:         }
244: 
245:         $body = trim($body);
246: 
247:         if ($validateConfiguration && ! $usesTemplate && $body === '') {
248:             throw new RuntimeException('El mensaje de texto no puede estar vacío.');
249:         }
250: 
251:         $contentVariables = $usesTemplate ? $this->twilioContentVariables($message, $template) : [];
252: 
253:         $payload = [
254:             'mode' => $resolvedMode,
255:             'from' => $from ? $this->normalizeWhatsAppAddress($from) : null,
256:             'to' => $this->normalizeWhatsAppRecipient($recipient),
257:             'body' => $body,
258:             'content_sid' => $usesTemplate ? $contentSid : null,
259:             'content_variables' => $contentVariables,
260:         ];
261: 
262:         $requestPayload = array_filter([
263:             'From' => $payload['from'],
264:             'To' => $payload['to'],
265:             'Body' => $usesTemplate ? null : $payload['body'],
266:             'ContentSid' => $payload['content_sid'],
267:             'ContentVariables' => $contentVariables !== [] ? $this->jsonEncode($contentVariables) : null,
268:             'StatusCallback' => $this->twilioStatusCallbackUrl(),
269:         ], static fn ($value) => $value !== null && $value !== '');
270: 
271:         return [$payload, $requestPayload];
272:     }
273: 
274:     public function resolveTwilioMode(?string $mode = null): string
275:     {
276:         $credential = WhatsAppCredential::get();
277:         $requestedMode = strtolower(trim($mode ?: $credential->resolveMode()));
278: 
279:         if (! in_array($requestedMode, $this->twilioModes(), true)) {
280:             throw new RuntimeException('Unsupported Twilio WhatsApp mode: '.$requestedMode);
281:         }
282: 
283:         if ($requestedMode !== self::TWILIO_AUTO_MODE) {
284:             return $requestedMode;
285:         }
286: 
287:         $from = (string) ($credential->resolveFrom() ?? '');
288: 
289:         if ($from !== '' && $this->normalizeWhatsAppAddress($from) === 'whatsapp:+14155238886') {
290:             return self::TWILIO_SANDBOX_MODE;
291:         }
292: 
293:         return self::TWILIO_SENDER_MODE;
294:     }
295: 
296:     /**
297:      * @return list<string>
298:      */
299:     private function twilioModes(): array
300:     {
301:         return [
302:             self::TWILIO_AUTO_MODE,
303:             self::TWILIO_SANDBOX_MODE,
304:             self::TWILIO_SENDER_MODE,
305:         ];
306:     }
307: 
308:     /**
309:      * @return array<string, string>
310:      */
311:     private function twilioContentVariables(?WhatsAppMessage $message, ?TwilioContentTemplate $template = null): array
312:     {
313:         Carbon::setLocale('es');
314:         $template ??= $this->twilioContentTemplate(scope: $this->twilioTemplateScope($message));
315:         $variables = $template?->content_variables ?? [];
316: 
317:         if (! is_array($variables)) {
318:             return [];
319:         }
320: 
321:         $scheduledFor = $message?->appointment?->scheduledFor() ?? $message?->scheduled_for;
322:         $fakeScheduledFor = now()->addDay()->setTime(10, 30);
323:         $scheduledValue = $scheduledFor ?? $fakeScheduledFor;
324:         $replacements = [
325:             '[NOMBRE]' => (string) ($message?->nombre ?? 'Ana'),
326:             '[APELLIDOS]' => (string) ($message?->apellidos ?? 'López'),
327:             '[TELEFONO]' => (string) ($message?->telefono ?? '+34600123123'),
328:             '[DIA]' => $scheduledValue?->translatedFormat('l j \d\e F') ?? '',
329:             '[FECHA]' => $scheduledValue?->translatedFormat('l j \d\e F') ?? '',
330:             '[HORA]' => $scheduledValue?->format('H:i') ?? '',
331:             '[MENSAJE]' => $message?->message ?? 'Mensaje de prueba',
332:         ];
333: 
334:         return collect($variables)
335:             ->mapWithKeys(fn (mixed $value, int|string $key): array => [
336:                 (string) $key => strtr((string) $value, $replacements),
337:             ])
338:             ->all();
339:     }
340: 
341:     private function buildFakeTemplateMessage(string $recipient, string $body): WhatsAppMessage
342:     {
343:         return new WhatsAppMessage([
344:             'nombre' => 'Ana',
345:             'apellidos' => 'López',
346:             'telefono' => $recipient,
347:             'scheduled_for' => now()->addDay()->setTime(10, 30),
348:             'message' => $body,
349:         ]);
350:     }
351: 
352:     /**
353:      * @param  array<string, string>  $value
354:      */
355:     private function jsonEncode(array $value): string
356:     {
357:         try {
358:             return json_encode($value, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE);
359:         } catch (JsonException $exception) {
360:             throw new RuntimeException('Twilio content variables could not be encoded.', previous: $exception);
361:         }
362:     }
363: 
364:     /**
365:      * @return array{provider:string,message_id:?string,payload:array,raw:array}
366:      *
367:      * @throws RequestException
368:      */
369:     private function sendViaCloudApi(WhatsAppMessage $message): array
370:     {
371:         $credential = WhatsAppCredential::get();
372:         $phoneNumberId = $credential->resolveCloudApiPhoneNumberId();
373:         $accessToken = $credential->resolveCloudApiAccessToken();
374: 
375:         if (! $phoneNumberId || ! $accessToken) {
376:             throw new RuntimeException('WhatsApp Cloud API credentials are not configured.');
377:         }
378: 
379:         $payload = $this->buildTextPayload($message);
380: 
381:         $response = Http::baseUrl(rtrim($credential->resolveCloudApiBaseUrl(), '/'))
382:             ->acceptJson()
383:             ->asJson()
384:             ->withToken($accessToken)
385:             ->timeout($credential->resolveCloudApiTimeout())
386:             ->connectTimeout($credential->resolveConnectTimeout())
387:             ->post(sprintf('/%s/%s/messages', $credential->resolveCloudApiVersion(), $phoneNumberId), $payload)
388:             ->throw()
389:             ->json();
390: 
391:         return [
392:             'provider' => 'cloud_api',
393:             'message_id' => data_get($response, 'messages.0.id'),
394:             'payload' => $payload,
395:             'raw' => $response,
396:         ];
397:     }
398: 
399:     /**
400:      * @return array{provider:string,message_id:?string,payload:array,raw:array}
401:      *
402:      * @throws RequestException
403:      */
404:     private function sendTestViaCloudApi(string $recipient, string $body): array
405:     {
406:         $credential = WhatsAppCredential::get();
407:         $phoneNumberId = $credential->resolveCloudApiPhoneNumberId();
408:         $accessToken = $credential->resolveCloudApiAccessToken();
409: 
410:         if (! $phoneNumberId || ! $accessToken) {
411:             throw new RuntimeException('WhatsApp Cloud API credentials are not configured.');
412:         }
413: 
414:         $payload = [
415:             'messaging_product' => 'whatsapp',
416:             'to' => $this->normalizeInternationalPhone($recipient),
417:             'type' => 'text',
418:             'text' => [
419:                 'preview_url' => false,
420:                 'body' => $body,
421:             ],
422:         ];
423: 
424:         $response = Http::baseUrl(rtrim($credential->resolveCloudApiBaseUrl(), '/'))
425:             ->acceptJson()
426:             ->asJson()
427:             ->withToken($accessToken)
428:             ->timeout($credential->resolveCloudApiTimeout())
429:             ->connectTimeout($credential->resolveConnectTimeout())
430:             ->post(sprintf('/%s/%s/messages', $credential->resolveCloudApiVersion(), $phoneNumberId), $payload)
431:             ->throw()
432:             ->json();
433: 
434:         return [
435:             'provider' => 'cloud_api',
436:             'message_id' => data_get($response, 'messages.0.id'),
437:             'payload' => $payload,
438:             'raw' => $response,
439:         ];
440:     }
441: 
442:     private function buildTextPayload(WhatsAppMessage $message): array
443:     {
444:         $body = $message->message;
445: 
446:         return [
447:             'messaging_product' => 'whatsapp',
448:             'to' => $message->normalizedPhone(),
449:             'type' => 'text',
450:             'text' => [
451:                 'preview_url' => false,
452:                 'body' => $body,
453:             ],
454:         ];
455:     }
456: 
457:     public function twilioContentSid(?string $scope = null): ?string
458:     {
459:         return $this->twilioContentTemplate(scope: $scope)?->content_sid;
460:     }
461: 
462:     public function twilioContentTemplate(?int $templateId = null, ?string $scope = null): ?TwilioContentTemplate
463:     {
464:         if ($templateId) {
465:             return TwilioContentTemplate::query()->find($templateId);
466:         }
467: 
468:         if ($scope === self::TEMPLATE_SCOPE_APPOINTMENT_REMINDER) {
469:             $configuredTemplateId = AppSetting::get()->twilio_template_appointment_reminder_id;
470: 
471:             if ($configuredTemplateId) {
472:                 return TwilioContentTemplate::query()->find($configuredTemplateId);
473:             }
474:         }
475: 
476:         if ($scope === self::TEMPLATE_SCOPE_APPOINTMENT_CREATED) {
477:             $configuredTemplateId = AppSetting::get()->twilio_template_appointment_created_id;
478: 
479:             if ($configuredTemplateId) {
480:                 return TwilioContentTemplate::query()->find($configuredTemplateId);
481:             }
482:         }
483: 
484:         return TwilioContentTemplate::query()->orderBy('id')->first();
485:     }
486: 
487:     private function twilioStatusCallbackUrl(): string
488:     {
489:         $credential = WhatsAppCredential::get();
490: 
491:         if (! $credential->webhookEnabled()) {
492:             return '';
493:         }
494: 
495:         $configuredUrl = $credential->resolveStatusCallbackUrl();
496: 
497:         return $configuredUrl !== ''
498:             ? $configuredUrl
499:             : route('webhooks.twilio.whatsapp-status', absolute: true);
500:     }
501: 
502:     private function shouldUseTwilioTemplate(WhatsAppMessage $message): bool
503:     {
504:         return ! (bool) data_get($message->metadata, 'history_reply', false);
505:     }
506: 
507:     private function twilioTemplateScope(?WhatsAppMessage $message): ?string
508:     {
509:         $scope = (string) data_get($message?->metadata, 'twilio_template_scope', '');
510: 
511:         return in_array($scope, [
512:             self::TEMPLATE_SCOPE_APPOINTMENT_REMINDER,
513:             self::TEMPLATE_SCOPE_APPOINTMENT_CREATED,
514:         ], true) ? $scope : null;
515:     }
516: }
````

````php
 44:     protected static function booted(): void
 45:     {
 46:         static::creating(function (self $appointment): void {
 47:             $appointment->fecha_original ??= $appointment->fecha;
 48:             $appointment->hora_original ??= $appointment->hora;
 49:         });
 50: 
 51:         static::updating(function (self $appointment): void {
 52:             if (! $appointment->wasChangedSchedule() || ($appointment->fecha_original && filled($appointment->hora_original))) {
 53:                 return;
 54:             }
 55: 
 56:             $appointment->fecha_original ??= $appointment->getOriginal('fecha');
 57:             $appointment->hora_original ??= $appointment->getOriginal('hora');
 58:         });
 59: 
 60:         static::updated(function (self $appointment): void {
 61:             if (! $appointment->wasChangedSchedule()) {
 62:                 return;
 63:             }
 64: 
 65:             $appointment->changes()->create([
 66:                 'fecha_anterior' => $appointment->getOriginal('fecha'),
 67:                 'hora_anterior' => $appointment->getOriginal('hora'),
 68:                 'fecha_nueva' => $appointment->fecha->toDateString(),
 69:                 'hora_nueva' => $appointment->hora,
 70:             ]);
 71:         });
 72:     }

 74:     public function wasChangedSchedule(): bool
 75:     {

100:             ->latestOfMany();

103:     public function hasTextResponse(): bool
104:     {
105:         $latest = $this->latestInboundAfterLastSent();
106: 
107:         if (! $latest) {
108:             return false;
109:         }
110: 
111:         return ! $latest->isConfirmed() && ! $latest->isRescheduleRequested();
112:     }
113: 
114:     public function hasUnreadInboundResponse(): bool
115:     {
116:         $latest = $this->latestInboundAfterLastSent();
117: 
118:         if (! $latest) {
119:             return false;
120:         }
121: 
122:         $seenAt = $this->last_inbound_seen_at;
123:         $messageTimestamp = $latest->responded_at ?? $latest->created_at;
124: 
125:         if (! $messageTimestamp) {
126:             return false;
127:         }
128: 
129:         return $seenAt === null || $messageTimestamp->gt($seenAt);
130:     }
131: 
132:     public function markLatestInboundAsSeen(): void
133:     {
134:         $latest = $this->latestInboundAfterLastSent();
135: 
136:         if (! $latest) {
137:             return;
138:         }
139: 
140:         $messageTimestamp = $latest->responded_at ?? $latest->created_at;
141: 
142:         if (! $messageTimestamp) {
143:             return;
144:         }
145: 
146:         if ($this->last_inbound_seen_at !== null && ! $messageTimestamp->gt($this->last_inbound_seen_at)) {
147:             return;
148:         }
149: 
150:         $this->forceFill([
151:             'last_inbound_seen_at' => $messageTimestamp,
152:         ])->save();
153:     }

155:     public function latestInboundAfterLastSent(): ?WhatsAppMessage
156:     {
157:         if ($this->relationLoaded('whatsAppMessages')) {
158:             /** @var Collection<int, WhatsAppMessage> $messages */
159:             $messages = $this->getRelation('whatsAppMessages');
160: 
161:             $lastSent = $messages
162:                 ->filter(fn (WhatsAppMessage $message): bool => in_array($message->direction, [null, WhatsAppMessage::DIRECTION_OUTBOUND], true) && $message->sent_at !== null)
163:                 ->sortByDesc(fn (WhatsAppMessage $message): int => $message->sent_at?->timestamp ?? 0)
164:                 ->first();
165: 
166:             $inboundMessages = $messages
167:                 ->filter(fn (WhatsAppMessage $message): bool => $message->direction === WhatsAppMessage::DIRECTION_INBOUND);
168: 
169:             if (! $lastSent) {
170:                 return $inboundMessages
171:                     ->sortByDesc(fn (WhatsAppMessage $message): int => $message->created_at?->timestamp ?? 0)
172:                     ->first();
173:             }
174: 
175:             return $inboundMessages
176:                 ->filter(fn (WhatsAppMessage $message): bool => $message->created_at !== null && $message->created_at->gte($lastSent->created_at))
177:                 ->sortByDesc(fn (WhatsAppMessage $message): int => $message->created_at?->timestamp ?? 0)
178:                 ->first();
179:         }
180: 
181:         $lastSent = $this->whatsAppMessages()
182:             ->outbound()
183:             ->whereNotNull('sent_at')
184:             ->orderByDesc('sent_at')
185:             ->first();
186: 
187:         if (! $lastSent) {
188:             return $this->whatsAppMessages()
189:                 ->where('direction', WhatsAppMessage::DIRECTION_INBOUND)
190:                 ->orderByDesc('created_at')
191:                 ->first();
192:         }
193: 
194:         return $this->whatsAppMessages()
195:             ->where('direction', WhatsAppMessage::DIRECTION_INBOUND)
196:             ->where('created_at', '>=', $lastSent->created_at)
197:             ->orderByDesc('created_at')
198:             ->first();
199:     }
````

````php
1248:         $otherClient = Client::query()->create([

1251:             'telefono' => '+34699111222',
1252:         ]);

1255:             Appointment::query()->create(['client_id' => $client->id, 'fecha' => '2026-06-25', 'hora' => '10:00', 'enviado' => false, 'activo' => true]),

1257:         $otherAppointment = Appointment::query()->create([

1262:             'activo' => true,
1263:         ]);

1266:             ->set('selectedAppointmentIds', [...$appointments->pluck('id'), $otherAppointment->id])
1267:             ->assertSee('Activar seleccionadas')
1268:             ->assertSee('Desactivar seleccionadas')
1269:             ->call('updateSelectedActiveStatus', false)

1277:             ->call('updateSelectedActiveStatus', true);

1720:     public function test_appointment_edit_can_send_whatsapp_immediately(): void
1721:     {
1722:         Carbon::setTestNow('2026-06-23 09:00:00');
1723: 
1724:         $admin = User::factory()->create();
1725:         $client = Client::query()->create([
1726:             'nombre' => 'Ana',
1727:             'apellidos' => 'Pérez',
1728:             'telefono' => '+34600111222',
1729:         ]);
1730:         $appointment = Appointment::query()->create([
1731:             'client_id' => $client->id,
1732:             'fecha' => '2026-06-30',
1733:             'hora' => '11:30',
1734:             'enviado' => false,
1735:             'activo' => true,
1736:         ]);
1737: 
1738:         Config::set('whatsapp.driver', 'twilio');
1739:         Config::set('whatsapp.message_mode', 'text');
1740:         Config::set('whatsapp.twilio.account_sid', 'AC123');
1741:         Config::set('whatsapp.twilio.auth_token', 'test-token');
1742:         Config::set('whatsapp.twilio.mode', 'sandbox');
1743:         Config::set('whatsapp.twilio.from', 'whatsapp:+14155238886');
1744: 
1745:         Http::fake([
1746:             'api.twilio.com/*/Messages.json' => Http::response([
1747:                 'sid' => 'SMAPPOINTMENTEDIT123',
1748:                 'status' => 'delivered',
1749:             ], 201),
1750:         ]);
1751: 
1752:         $this->actingAs($admin);
1753: 
1754:         $component = Livewire::test(AppointmentForm::class)
1755:             ->set('isEditing', true)
1756:             ->set('selectedAppointmentId', $appointment->id)
1757:             ->set('selectedClientId', $client->id)
1758:             ->set('fecha', '2026-06-30')
1759:             ->set('hora', '11:30')
1760:             ->set('enviado', false)
1761:             ->set('activo', true);
1762: 
1763:         $this->assertStringContainsString('wire:click="sendNow"', $component->html());
1764:         $this->assertStringNotContainsString('wire:click="sendNow" disabled="disabled"', $component->html());
1765: 
1766:         $component
1767:             ->call('sendNow')
1768:             ->assertSee('WhatsApp enviado ahora correctamente.');
1769: 
1770:         Http::assertSent(function ($request): bool {
1771:             return $request->url() === 'https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/AC123/Messages.json'
1772:                 && $request['From'] === 'whatsapp:+14155238886'
1773:                 && $request['To'] === 'whatsapp:+34600111222'
1774:                 && $request['Body'] === 'Hola Ana te recordamos que el día 30/06/2026 tienes una cita a las 11:30 ; saludos Clínica Dental Eugenia';
1775:         });
1776: 
1777:         $message = WhatsAppMessage::query()->firstOrFail();
1778: 
1779:         $appointment->refresh();
1780: 
1781:         $this->assertTrue($appointment->enviado);
1782:         $this->assertTrue($appointment->entregado);
1783:         $this->assertSame($appointment->id, $message->appointment_id);
1784:         $this->assertSame(WhatsAppMessage::STATUS_SENT, $message->status);
1785:         $this->assertSame('SMAPPOINTMENTEDIT123', $message->provider_message_id);
1786:         $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Esta cita ya fue enviada o pertenece al pasado.', $component->html());
1787:         $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Enviar ya', $component->html());
1788:         $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Guardar cambios', $component->html());
1789:         $this->assertStringNotContainsString('Cancelar', $component->html());
1790:         $this->assertStringContainsString('Volver', $component->html());
1791: 
1792:         Carbon::setTestNow();
1793:     }
````
